units.slavonic_diplomatic: ☞ *Вѣ́домо бꙋ́ди: А҆́ще слꙋчи́тся недѣ́ля предъ ржⷭ҇тво́мъ деке́мврїа въ к҃д де́нь, ничто́же* --- Page 157 --- *воскр́но пое́мъ развѣ̀ степе́нны, Прокі́мена оу҆́треннагѡ и҆ Є҆ѵг҃лїа, и҆* Воскр́нїе Хрⷭ҇то́во *глаго́лемъ. Слꙋ́жба же вся̀ быва́етъ сты́хъ ѻ҆це́въ и҆ предпра́здниства. Предваря́ютже сты̑мъ ѻ҆це́мъ стїхи̑ры, и҆ пое́мъ на* Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ: *стїхи̑ры ѻ҆це́въ на ѕ҃, и҆ предпра́здниства на д҃, сла́ва ѻ҆це́въ, и҆ ны́нѣ предпра́здниства, и҆ про́чая слꙋ́жба по чи́нꙋ. На літꙋргі́и, по вхо́дѣ: тропа́рь воскрнъ, и҆ ѻ҆це́въ и҆ предпра́здниства, сла́ва конда́къ ѻ҆це́въ, и҆ ны́нѣ предпра́здниства. А҆́пл҃ъ и҆ Є҆ѵг҃лїе ѻ҆це́въ, пото́мъ ря́дъ. А҆́ще же бꙋ́детъ ѿстꙋ́пка недѣ́лямъ, ря́дъ нл҃и а҆́пла и҆ є҆ѵг҃лїа не чте́мъ.*
units.english_cohort_translation: [Book Page 157] *of the Sunday Resurrection do we sing, except the Graduals, the Matins Prokeimenon and Gospel, and* **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** *we say. But the entire office is of the Holy Fathers and of the Forefeast. The stichera of the Holy Fathers precede, and we sing at* **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Го́споди воззва́хъ*): *stichera of the Fathers to 6, and of the Forefeast to 4; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:" of the Fathers; "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" of the Forefeast; and the rest of the office in order. At the Divine Liturgy, after the Entrance: Sunday Resurrection troparion, and of the Fathers, and of the Forefeast; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:" kontakion of the Fathers; "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" of the Forefeast. Epistle and Gospel of the Fathers, thereafter of the cycle. But if there be a deferral for the Sundays, the ordinary Sunday Epistle and Gospel we do not read.*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Подоба́етъ вѣ́дати ѡ҆ часѣ́хъ въ навече́рїи Ржⷭ҇тва Хрⷭ҇то́ва. А҆́ще слꙋчи́тся ржⷭ҇тво̀ Хрⷭ҇то́во въ нл҃ю и҆лѝ въ понедѣ́лникъ: Часы̀ пое́мъ пре́жде въ пато́къ. А҆́щели ржⷭ҇тво̀ Хрⷭ҇то́во во Вто́рникъ, въ Средꙋ̀, въ Че́твертокъ, въ Пато́къ и҆ Сꙋббѡ́тꙋ: часы̀ пое́мъ въ навече́рїи.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *It is necessary to know concerning the Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ: If the Nativity of Christ occur on a Sunday or on a Monday, we sing the Hours beforehand on Friday. But if the Nativity of Christ occur on a Tuesday, on a Wednesday, on a Thursday, on a Friday, and on a Saturday, we sing the Hours on the Eve.*[^172]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Въ нача́лѣ в҃ гѡ часа̀, [в҃ й ча́съ прѐ полꙋднѐ] зна́менꙋетъ въ кампа́нъ. И҆ совра́вшымся въ хра́мъ, ѡ҆блачи́тся і҆ере́й въ фело́нъ, дїа́конъ же въ стїха́рь. И҆ поставля́етъ цр҃ко́вникъ а҆нало́гїй оу҆краше́нъ пря́мѡ ца́рскихъ вра́тъ: и҆ вжига́етъ свѣщꙋ̀ на свѣ́щницѣ. І҆ере́й же взе́мъ со ѻ҆лтаря̀ ст҃о́е є҆ѵг҃лїе, и҆схо́дитъ со є҆ѵг҃лїемъ во хра́мъ цр҃кими враты̀, предходя́щꙋ є҆мꙋ̀ дїа́конꙋ съ кади́ломъ. И҆ полага́етъ*
units.english_cohort_translation: *At the beginning of the 2nd hour [the 2nd hour before noon], the bell strikes. And having assembled in church, the priest vests in phelonion, and the deacon in sticharion. units.slavonic_diplomatic: *і҆ере́й ст҃о́е є҆ѵг҃лїе на а҆нало́гїи, и҆ ста́въ предъ а҆нало́гїемъ, твори́тъ нача́ло по ѻ҆бы́чаю:* Благослове́нъ Бг҃ъ на́шъ: *и҆ по нача́лѣ чте́цъ:* Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Цр҃ю̀ нб҃сны́й, *и҆ про́чая. И҆ по возгла́сѣ кади́тъ сщ҃е́нникъ ст҃о́е є҆ѵг҃лїе, на а҆нало́гїи ѡ҆́крестъ, и҆ про́чыя і҆ко́ны, и҆ хра́мъ ве́сь и҆ настоя́телѧ и҆ бра́тїю, и҆ ѿда́въ кади́льницꙋ стои́тъ чре́зъ всѐ послѣ́дованїе по дре́вномꙋ оу҆ста́вꙋ предъ а҆нало́гїемъ. Чте́цъ же чте́тъ Ѱалмы̀ часе́въ ца́рскихъ: я҆́коже въ Часосло́вѣ. Та́же пое́мъ тропарѝ по в҃ (на гла́съ самогла́сенъ). Посе́мъ прокі́менъ. Та́же парамі́а а̄, А҆́пл҃ъ, ко є҆вре́емъ зач. тг҃. и҆ є҆ѵг҃лїе Мат. зач. в҃. Та́же чтꙋ́тъ:* Стопы̀ моя̀ напра́ви, *трїсто́е. По* Оу҆́че на́шъ: *конда́къ:* Дѣ́ва дне́сь. Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй м҃. *И҆ моли́тва:* И҆́же на вся́кое вре́мя: По честнѣ́йшꙋю харꙋвїмъ: *І҆ере́й:* Бж҃е оу҆ще́дри ны̀: *Та́же моли́тва:* Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣ́те: *Посе́мъ ча́съ г҃, ѕ҃, и҆ ѳ҃ й подо́бнѣ пое́тся. На ѳ҃ мъ часѣ̀ кади́тъ І҆ере́й ве́сь хра́мъ, я҆́кѡже на пе́рвомъ. По моли́твѣ ѳ҃ гѡ часа̀:* Влⷣко Гдⷭ҇и І҆и҃се Хрⷭ҇тѐ: *а҆́бїе* Благословѝ дꙋ́ше моя̀ Гдⷭ҇а. Сла́ва: Хвалѝ дꙋшѐ: *и҆ ны́нѣ* Є҆диноро́дный: сы́не: *И҆* во црⷭ҇твїи твое́мъ помянѝ: Вѣ́рꙋю въ є҆ди́нагѡ Бг҃а: Ѡ҆сла́би, ѡ҆ста́ви: *По* Оу҆́че на́шъ: *конда́къ праз.* Дѣ́ва дне́сь: Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй м҃, *и҆ моли́тва* Всеста́я трⷪце. *Та́же а҆́бїе* Досто́йнѡ є҆́сть. *И҆ Ѿпꙋ́стъ. И҆ быва́етъ расхо́дъ, до часа̀ вече́рнагѡ. Вече́рна же быва́етъ съ літꙋргі́ею Васи́лїа великагѡ по́зднѣе.*
units.english_cohort_translation: [Book Page 158] *the Holy Gospel upon the tetrapod; and standing before the tetrapod, makes the beginning according to custom:* **"Blessed is our God..."** (*Благослове́нъ Бо́гъ на́шъ...*); *and after the beginning the reader says:* **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee. O Heavenly King..."** (*Сла́ва Тебѣ̀, Бо́же на́шъ, сла́ва Тебѣ̀. Царю̀ Небе́сный...*), *and the rest. And after the exclamation, the priest censes the Holy Gospel on the tetrapod round about, and the other icons, and the whole church, and the Superior and the brethren; and having returned the censer, stands throughout the entire office according to the ancient Typikon before the tetrapod. And the reader reads the Psalms of the Royal Hours, as in the Horologion. Then we sing the troparia by 2 (to the self-governing tone). Thereafter the Prokeimenon. Then the 1st Paremia; the Epistle to the Hebrews, pericope 303; and the Gospel from Matthew, pericope 2. Then they read:* **"Order my steps..."** (*Стопы̀ моя̀ напра́ви...*); *the Trisagion. After* **"Our Father"**: *the kontakion:* **"The Virgin today..."** (*Дѣ́ва дне́сь...*); **"Lord, have mercy"** *40 times; and the prayer:* **"Thou Who at all times..."** (*И҆́же на вся́кое вре́мя...*). *After* **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**: *the priest:* **"God be gracious unto us..."** (*Бо́же, оу҆ще́дри ны̀...*). *Then the prayer:* **"O Christ, the True Light..."** (*Христѐ, Свѣ́те...*). *Thereafter the 3rd, 6th, and 9th Hours are sung similarly. At the 9th Hour the priest censes the whole church, as at the 1st. After the prayer of the 9th Hour:* **"O Master, Lord Jesus Christ..."** (*Влады́ко Го́споди І҆исоу́се Христѐ...*); *immediately:* **"Bless the Lord, O my soul"** (*Благословѝ, душѐ моя̀, Го́спода*); **"Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:"** **"Praise the Lord, O my soul"** (*Хвалѝ, душѐ моя̀, Го́спода*); **"Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:"** **"Only-begotten Son..."** (*Е҆диноро́дный Сы́не...*); *and* **"In Thy kingdom remember us..."** (*Во Ца́рствїи Твое́мъ помянѝ на́съ...*); **"I believe in one God..."** (*Вѣ́рую во є҆ди́наго Бо́га...*); **"Remit, pardon..."** (*Ѡ҆сла́би, ѡ҆ста́ви...*). *After* **"Our Father"**: *festal kontakion:* **"The Virgin today..."**; **"Lord, have mercy"** *40 times; and the prayer:* **"All-Holy Trinity..."** (*Всесвята́я Тро́ице...*). *Then immediately:* **"It is truly meet..."** (*Досто́йно є҆́сть...*); *and the Dismissal. And the departure takes place until the evening hour. But Vespers is celebrated with the Liturgy of Basil the Great later.*[^173]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: вход бывает со еглием по скончании и чтений
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Вхо́дъ быва́етъ со є҆г҃лїемъ. По сконча́нїи и҆ чте́нїй со стиха́ми, быва́етъ є҆кте́нїа ма́лая. И҆ по возгла́сѣ Трїсто́е. Та́же Прокі́менъ гла́съ д҃:* Гдⷭ҇ь речѐ ко мнѣ̀: сн҃ъ мо́й є҆сѝ ты̀: *А҆́пл҃ъ ко є҆вре́емъ зач. тг҃. Є҆ѵг҃лїе ѿ Лꙋкѝ зач. є҃:* И҆зы́де повелѣ́нїе ѿ ке́сара А҆ѵгꙋ́ста. *И҆ по ря́дꙋ Бж҃твенная літꙋргі́а вели́кагѡ Васи́лїа. За досто́йнѡ пое́мъ:* Ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ ра́дꙋется. *По ѿпꙋ́стѣ вжига́етъ параекклесїа́рхъ свѣ́щникъ, и҆ поставля́етъ є҆го̀ средѝ цр҃кве, кли́рицы же ста́вше ѻ҆́ба ли́ка вкꙋ́пѣ, пою́тъ тропа́рь пра́здника, Гла́съ Д҃:* Ржⷭ҇тво̀ твоѐ: *Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ конда́къ,* Дѣ́ва дне́сь. *И҆схо́димъ въ трапе́зꙋ и҆ я҆ди́мъ варе́нїе съ є҆ле́емъ.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *The Entrance is made with the Gospel. After the conclusion of the 8 readings with their verses, the Little Ectene takes place. And after the exclamation, the Trisagion. Then the Prokeimenon, Tone 4:* **"The Lord said unto Me: Thou art My Son..."** (*Госпо́дь рече́ ко Мнѣ̀: Сы́нъ Мо́й є҆сѝ Ты̀...*); *Epistle to the Hebrews, pericope 303; Gospel from Luke, pericope 5:* **"A decree went forth from Caesar Augustus..."** (*И҆зы́де повелѣ́нїе ѿ ке́саря А҆́вгуста...*). *And in order the Divine Liturgy of Basil the Great. Instead of "It is truly meet", we sing:* **"In thee rejoices..."** (*Ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ ра́дуется...*). *After the Dismissal, the paramonarios lights a candle-stand and places it in the midst of the church; and the clerics of both choirs, standing together, sing the troparion of the feast, Tone 4:* **"Thy Nativity, O Christ our God..."** (*Рождество̀ Твоѐ, Христѐ Бо́же на́шъ...*); **"Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:"** *kontakion:* **"The Virgin today..."** (*Дѣ́ва дне́сь...*). *We go forth to the refectory and eat cooked food with oil.*[^174]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *А҆́ще слꙋчи́тся навече́рїе Хрⷭ҇то́ва ржⷭ҇тва̀ въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ и҆лѝ недѣ́лю, часы̀ цр҃кїа пое́мъ пре́жде въ пато́къ, по ѻ҆бы́чаю я҆́коже оу҆каза́ся на рядꙋ̀ ли́стъ 157, гла́емъ же на ни́хъ и҆ Ѱало́мъ л҃г:* Благословлю̀ Гдⷭ҇а на вся́кое вре́мя: *и҆ Ѿпꙋ́стъ, поне́же літꙋргі́а въ то́й де́нь [сїе́сть в пато́къ] не быва́етъ, но вече́рна во свое́ вре́мя. units.english_cohort_translation: *If the Eve of the Nativity of Christ occur on a Saturday or Sunday, we sing the Royal Hours beforehand on Friday, according to custom as indicated on leaf 157; and on them we also say Psalm 33:* **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (*Благословлю̀ Го́спода на вся́кое вре́мя*); *and the Dismissal: because a Liturgy is not celebrated on that day [that is, on Friday], but Vespers at its proper time. On Saturday or Sunday [on the Eve], the Liturgy takes place...*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: при часе же з м дне начинаем вечерню
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *При часѣ́ же з҃ мъ днѐ начина́емъ вече́рню. По ѻ҆бы́чномъ ѱалмѣ̀, и҆ по є҆кте́нїи, пое́тся* Блаже́нъ мꙋ́жъ: *а҆́ще сꙋббѡ́та всю̀ каѳ., а҆́ще нл҃я а̄ й а҆нтїфѡ́нъ. На* Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ *ста́вимъ стїхѡ́въ и҃. пра́з. Вхо́дъ со є҆г҃лїемъ. Прокі́менъ днѐ. Чте́нїа по чи́нꙋ и҆́хъ со стїха́ми. По парамїа́хъ, а҆́бїе є҆кте́нїа ма́лаѧ. И҆ по возгла́сѣ, прокі́менъ гла́съ д҃:* Гдⷭ҇ь рече́ ко мнѣ̀: *а҆́пл҃ъ къ гала́томъ зач. с҃з,* По человѣ́кꙋ глаго́лю: *є҆г҃лїе Мат. зач. н҃г. Посе́мъ є҆кте́нїа:* Рце́мъ всѝ. *Та́же* Сподо́би Гдⷭ҇и: И҆спо́лнимъ вече́рняѧ: *И҆ возгла́съ:* Ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ: Ми́ръ всѣ̑мъ: *и҆ в҃ й возгла́съ:* Бꙋ́ди держа́ва: *И҆ посе́мъ а҆́бїе* Премꙋ́дрость: *Ли́къ;* Бл҃гословѝ. *І҆ер.* Сы́й бл҃гослове́нъ: *и҆ про́ч: и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. (Стїхо́вной нѣ́сть). По ѿпꙋ́стѣ же вжига́емъ свѣ́щникъ средѝ це́ркве, и҆ ста́вше ѻ҆́ба ли́ка вкꙋ́пѣ, пою́тъ тропа́рь пра́здника, сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ конда́къ. И҆ вхо́димъ въ тра́пезꙋ, и҆ я҆ди́мъ соверше́ннѡ со древянома́слїемъ и҆ сочиво ѡ҆́бварено, и҆лѝ кꙋтїю съ ме́домъ.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *At the 7th hour of the day, we begin Vespers. After the customary Psalm [Psalm 103], and after the ectene,* **"Blessed is the man"** (*Блаже́нъ мꙋ́жъ*) *is sung: if Saturday, the entire Kathisma; if Sunday, the 1st Antiphon. At* **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Го́споди воззва́хъ*): *we set 8 stichera of the feast. The Entrance is made with the Gospel. Prokeimenon of the day. The readings in their order with their verses. After the Paremias, immediately the Little Ectene. And after the exclamation, the Prokeimenon, Tone 4:* **"The Lord said unto Me: Thou art My Son..."** (*Госпо́дь рече́ ко Мнѣ̀: Сы́нъ Мо́й є҆сѝ Ты̀...*); *Epistle to the Galatians, pericope 207:* **"I speak after the manner of men..."** (*По человѣ́кꙋ глаго́лю...*); *Gospel from Matthew, pericope 53. Thereafter the ectene:* **"Let us all say..."** (*Рце́мъ всѝ...*). *Then:* **"Vouchsafe, O Lord..."** (*Сподо́би, Го́споди...*); **"Let us complete our evening prayer..."** (*И҆спо́лнимъ вече́рняя...*). *And the exclamation:* **"For Thou art a good God..."** (*Ꙗ҆́кѡ Бла́гъ Бо́гъ...*); **"Peace be unto all"** (*Ми́ръ всѣ̑мъ*); *and the 2nd exclamation:* **"Blessed and glorified be the majesty of Thy kingdom..."** (*Бꙋ́ди держа́ва ца́рствїя Твоегѡ̀...*). *And thereafter immediately:* **"Wisdom!"** (*Премꙋ́дрость!*). *Choir:* **"Bless"** (*Благословѝ*). *Priest:* **"Blessed is He Who is, Christ our God..."** (*Сы́й благослове́нъ Христо́съ Бо́гъ на́шъ...*); *and the rest, and the Dismissal. (There are no Aposticha). After the Dismissal, we light the candle-stand in the midst of the church, and both choirs standing together sing the troparion of the feast; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" the kontakion. And we enter into the refectory, and eat fully with oil, and boiled wheat, or kutia [kolivo] with honey.*[^175]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Вѣ́дати подоба́етъ: ꙗ҆́кѡ въ пра́здникъ рождества̀ Хрⷭ҇то́ва [и҆ Бг҃оявле́нїя] въ кі́йнибꙋдь де́нь прилꙋчи́тся, пое́тся повече́рїе вели́кое съ лїті́ею си́це: Ѡ҆ часѣ́ і҃ мъ но́щи: (сі́есть ѿ д҃ мъ часѣ̀ по полꙋ́нощи,) быва́етъ благовѣ́стъ въ є҆ди́нъ* --- Page 161 --- *и҆ пото́мъ трезво́нъ во вся̑ кампа́ны, и҆ вжига́етъ церко́вникъ свѣти́льники предъ і҆ко́ною спа́са и҆ Бц҃ы. І҆ере́й же ѡ҆бо́лкся твори́тъ нача́ло:* Бл҃гослове́нъ Бг҃ъ на́шъ: [*не ѿтворя́я ца́рскихъ вра́тъ*]. *И҆ кади́тъ і҆ко́ны и҆ ве́сь хра́мъ. Ли́къ же глаго́летъ повече́рїе вели́кое ѿ нача́ла.* Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Цр҃ю̀ нбⷭ҇ный: Трїсто́е *и҆ про́ч. я҆́коже въ Молитвосло́вѣ. И҆ по шестѝ ѱалмѣ́хъ и҆ по сла́ва: пое́тъ ли́къ съ предстоя́щими велегла́снѡ и҆ протяже́ннѡ.* Съ на́ми Бг҃ъ, разꙋмѣ́йте я҆зы́цы: *пе́рвый сті́хъ г҃. І҆ере́й же стоя̀ предъ ца́рскими враты̀ чте́тъ стїхѝ:* До послѣ́дныхъ землѝ, *и҆ про́ч Ли́къ по кое́мждо стїсѣ̀ пое́тъ:* Съ на́ми Бг҃ъ: *и҆ въ концѝ се́й сті́хъ г҃. Та́же:* Де́нь прише́дъ: Вѣ́рꙋю въ є҆ди́нагѡ Бг҃а. Прест҃ая Тр҃це: *кі́йждо сті́хъ по в҃. Посе́мъ Трїсто́е, и҆ по Ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ: Тропа́рь пра́здника а̄. Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй м҃. сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ:* Честнѣ́йшꙋю херꙋвї́мъ: И҆́менемъ Гдⷭ҇нимъ: *І҆ере́й* Моли́твами сты́хъ: *и҆ чте́тъ моли́твꙋ:* Гдⷭ҇и, Гдⷭ҇и и҆збавле́й на́съ: Прїиди́те поклони́мся: *г҃, и҆ Ѱало́мъ н҃, р҃а. Посе́мъ моли́тва ѿ І҆ере́а:* Гдⷭ҇и вседержи́телю: *Трїсто́е, и҆ по Ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ: конда́къ пра́здника,* Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй м҃ *сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ:* Честнѣ́йшꙋю: *І҆ере́й* Моли́твами сты́хъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ: *та́же моли́твꙋ* Вл҃ко Бж҃е Ѻ҆́ч҃е: *Посе́мъ ли́къ* прїиди́те поклони́мся. *Ѱало́мъ ѯ҃д, рм҃в, и҆ чте́тъ* Сла́ва во вы́шнихъ Бг҃ꙋ: *І҆ере́й кади́тъ і҆кѡ́ны и҆ ве́сь хра́мъ, и҆ по Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ, быва́етъ літі́а съ крⷭ҇то́мъ въ притво́ръ по ѻ҆́бычаю, я҆́кѡже на всено́щное*
units.english_cohort_translation: [Book Page 161] *and thereafter a festive chiming on all the bells; and the sacristan lights the lamps before the icon of the Savior and of the Theotokos. And the priest having vested makes the beginning:* **"Blessed is our God..."** (*Благослове́нъ Бо́гъ на́шъ...*) [*not opening the Royal Doors*]. *And he censes the icons and the whole church. And the choir says Great Compline from the beginning:* **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee. O Heavenly King..."** (*Сла́ва Тебѣ̀, Бо́же на́шъ, сла́ва Тебѣ̀. Царю̀ Небе́сный...*); *the Trisagion, and the rest, as in the Horologion. And after the Six Psalms and after "Glory...": the choir with those present sings in a loud voice and lingeringly:* **"God is with us, understand, O ye nations..."** (*Съ на́ми Бо́гъ, разꙋмѣ́йте, я҆зы́цы...*): *the first verse 3 times. And the priest standing before the Royal Doors reads the verses:* **"Even unto the uttermost parts of the earth..."** (*До послѣ́днихъ землѝ...*), *and the rest. After each verse the choir sings:* **"God is with us"** (*Съ на́ми Бо́гъ*); *and at the end, this verse 3 times. Then:* **"The day is past..."** (*Де́нь преше́дъ...*); **"I believe in one God..."** (*Вѣ́рую во є҆ди́наго Бо́га...*); **"All-Holy Trinity..."** (*Прест҃ая Тро́ице...*): *each verse 2 times each. Thereafter the Trisagion; and after "Our Father": the troparion of the feast, 1 time;* **"Lord, have mercy"** *40 times; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:"* **"More honorable than the Cherubim..."** (*Честнѣ́йшꙋю херꙋвї́мъ...*); **"In the name of the Lord..."** (*И҆́менемъ Госпо́днимъ...*). *Priest:* **"Through the prayers of the holy..."** (*Моли́твами святы́хъ...*); *and reads the prayer:* **"O Lord, Lord, Who hast delivered us..."** (*Го́споди, Го́споди, и҆збавле́й на́съ...*); **"Come, let us bow down in worship..."** (*Прїиди́те, поклони́мся...*) *3 times, and Psalm 50 [Psalm 51] and Psalm 101 [Psalm 102]. Thereafter the prayer by the priest:* **"O Lord Almighty..."** (*Го́споди Вседержи́телю...*); *the Trisagion, and after "Our Father": the kontakion of the feast;* **"Lord, have mercy"** *40 times; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:"* **"More honorable..."**; *Priest:* **"Through the prayers of the holy fathers..."** (*Моли́твами святы́хъ ѻ҆те́цъ...*); *then the prayer:* **"O Master, God the Father..."** (*Влады́ко Бо́же Ѻ҆́тче...*). *Thereafter the choir:* **"Come, let us bow down in worship..."**; *Psalm 69 [Psalm 70], Psalm 142 [Psalm 143]; and reads:* **"Glory to God in the highest..."** (*Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ Бо́гꙋ...*). *The priest censes the icons and the whole church; and after "Glory to God in the highest", the Litiya takes place with the cross into the narthex according to custom, as for an All-Night*

Посе́мъ моли́тва ѿ І҆ере́а:* Гдⷭ҇и вседержи́телю: *Трїсто́е, и҆ по Ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ: конда́къ пра́здника,* Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй м҃ *сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ:* Честнѣ́йшꙋю: *І҆ере́й* Моли́твами сты́хъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ: *та́же моли́твꙋ* Вл҃ко Бж҃е Ѻ҆́ч҃е: *Посе́мъ ли́къ* прїиди́те поклони́мся. *Ѱало́мъ ѯ҃д, рм҃в, и҆ чте́тъ* Сла́ва во вы́шнихъ Бг҃ꙋ: *І҆ере́й кади́тъ і҆кѡ́ны и҆ ве́сь хра́мъ, и҆ по Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ, быва́етъ літі́а съ крⷭ҇то́мъ въ притво́ръ по ѻ҆́бычаю, я҆́кѡже на всено́щное*
units.english_text: [Book Page 161] *and thereafter a festive chiming on all the bells; and the sacristan lights the lamps before the icon of the Savior and of the Theotokos. And the priest having vested makes the beginning:* **"Blessed is our God..."** (*Благослове́нъ Бо́гъ на́шъ...*) [*not opening the Royal Doors*]. *And he censes the icons and the whole church. And the choir says Great Compline from the beginning:* **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee. O Heavenly King..."** (*Сла́ва Тебѣ̀, Бо́же на́шъ, сла́ва Тебѣ̀. Царю̀ Небе́сный...*); *the Trisagion, and the rest, as in the Horologion. And after the Six Psalms and after "Glory...": the choir with those present sings in a loud voice and lingeringly:* **"God is with us, understand, O ye nations..."** (*Съ на́ми Бо́гъ, разꙋмѣ́йте, я҆зы́цы...*): *the first verse 3 times. And the priest standing before the Royal Doors reads the verses:* **"Even unto the uttermost parts of the earth..."** (*До послѣ́днихъ землѝ...*), *and the rest. After each verse the choir sings:* **"God is with us"** (*Съ на́ми Бо́гъ*); *and at the end, this verse 3 times. Then:* **"The day is past..."** (*Де́нь преше́дъ...*); **"I believe in one God..."** (*Вѣ́рую во є҆ди́наго Бо́га...*); **"All-Holy Trinity..."** (*Прест҃ая Тро́ице...*): *each verse 2 times each. Thereafter the Trisagion; and after "Our Father": the troparion of the feast, 1 time;* **"Lord, have mercy"** *40 times; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:"* **"More honorable than the Cherubim..."** (*Честнѣ́йшꙋю херꙋвї́мъ...*); **"In the name of the Lord..."** (*И҆́менемъ Госпо́днимъ...*). *Priest:* **"Through the prayers of the holy..."** (*Моли́твами святы́хъ...*); *and reads the prayer:* **"O Lord, Lord, Who hast delivered us..."** (*Го́споди, Го́споди, и҆збавле́й на́съ...*); **"Come, let us bow down in worship..."** (*Прїиди́те, поклони́мся...*) *3 times, and Psalm 50 [Psalm 51] and Psalm 101 [Psalm 102]. Thereafter the prayer by the priest:* **"O Lord Almighty..."** (*Го́споди Вседержи́телю...*); *the Trisagion, and after "Our Father": the kontakion of the feast;* **"Lord, have mercy"** *40 times; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:"* **"More honorable..."**; *Priest:* **"Through the prayers of the holy fathers..."** (*Моли́твами святы́хъ ѻ҆те́цъ...*); *then the prayer:* **"O Master, God the Father..."** (*Влады́ко Бо́же Ѻ҆́тче...*). *Thereafter the choir:* **"Come, let us bow down in worship..."**; *Psalm 69 [Psalm 70], Psalm 142 [Psalm 143]; and reads:* **"Glory to God in the highest..."** (*Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ Бо́гꙋ...*). *The priest censes the icons and the whole church; and after "Glory to God in the highest", the Litiya takes place with the cross into the narthex according to custom, as for an All-Night*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *бдѣ́нїе. И҆ пое́мъ на літі́и стїхи̑ры, Гла́съ а̄:* Не́бо и҆ земля̀: *Та́же по стїхи́рахъ гле́тъ і҆ере́й моли́твꙋ по ѻ҆бы́чаю бдѣ́нномꙋ:* Спасѝ Бж҃е люди твоѧ̑: *И҆ па́ки вше́дше въ хра́мъ, пое́мъ на стїхо́внѣ стїхи̑ры Гла́съ в҃:* Ве́лїе чꙋ́до: *съ припѣ́вами пра́з. по трїсто́мъ на благослове́нїи хлѣ́бѡвъ, тропа́рь пра́здника г҃. Та́же* бꙋ́ди и҆́мя Гдⷭ҇не: *г҃, съ пѣ́нїемъ, ѱало́мъ л҃г до нелиша́тся вся́кагѡ бл҃га. І҆ере́й:* благослове́нїе Гдⷭ҇не на ва́съ: *И҆ а҆́бїе ли́къ:* Сла́ва во вы́шнихъ Бг҃ꙋ: *г҃ шестоѱа́лмїе и҆ по рядꙋ̀ оу҆́трена, я҆́кѡже на вся̑ пра́здники Гдⷭ҇скїа.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *Vigil. And at the Litiya we sing the stichera, Tone 1:* **"Heaven and earth..."** (*Не́бо и҆ земля̀...*). *Then after the stichera, the priest says the prayer according to the custom of the Vigil:* **"Save, O God, Thy people..."** (*Спасѝ, Бо́же, лю́ди Твоя̑...*). *And having entered again into the church, we sing at the Aposticha the stichera, Tone 2:* **"A great marvel..."** (*Ве́лїе чꙋ́до...*), *with the festal refrains. After the Trisagion, at the blessing of the loaves, troparion of the feast 3 times. Then:* **"Blessed be the name of the Lord..."** (*Бꙋ́ди и҆́мя Госпо́дне...*) *3 times with singing; Psalm 33 [Psalm 34] as far as "shall not want any good thing." Priest:* **"The blessing of the Lord be upon you..."** (*Благослове́нїе Госпо́дне на ва́съ...*). *And immediately the choir:* **"Glory to God in the highest..."** *3 times; the Six Psalms, and in order Matins, as on all Feasts of the Lord.*[^176]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ☞ *А҆́ще пра́з рж҃тва̀ Хрⷭ҇то́ва слꙋчи́тся бы́ти во средꙋ и҆ пато́къ, разрѣша́емъ оу҆́бѡ мі́ряне на мя́со, мона́си на сы́ръ и҆ я҆и́ца, и҆ я҆ди́мъ оу҆́бѡ ѿ рж҃тва̀ Хрⷭ҇то́ва до навече́рїа вг҃оявле́нїа (е҆́же нарица́ется дванадесѧтдневно) по вся̑ днѝ та́же и҆ въ средꙋ и҆ пато́къ мірсті́и оу҆́бѡ мя́со, мона́си же сы́ръ и҆ я҆и́ца.*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Въ ве́черъ каѳі́сма не гле́тся, на* Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ: *ста́вимъ стїхѡ́въ ѕ҃; пра́з. и҆ про́ч. Вхо́дъ, Прокі́менъ вели́кїй Гла́съ з҃.* Кто̀ Бг҃ъ ве́лїй: *со стїхѝ. А҆́ще въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ ве́черъ, пое́мъ прокі́менъ:* Гдⷭ҇ь воцари́ся: *Предваря́етъ бо се́й прокі́менъ всѣ́хъ про́чихъ. Посе́мъ є҆кте́нїо: Рце́мъ всѝ: и҆ про́ч. [Літі́а не быва́етъ, развѣ̀ хра́ма]. На полꙋ́нощници, по а̄ мъ трⷭ҇то́мъ вмѣ́сто:* Се женихъ: *тропа́рь, пра́з-* --- Page 163 --- *дника,* Рж҃тво̀ твоѐ: *По в҃ мъ трїсто́мъ конда́къ гла́съ ѕ҃.* И҆́же пре́жде денни́цы. Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй, в҃і. *и҆ а҆́бїе ѿпꙋ́стъ. А҆ моли́твы:* Помянѝ Гдⷭ҇и въ наде́ждѣ *не гле́мъ. На оу҆́трени. На* Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь, *тропа́рь пра́здника, г҃. [Е҆ѵг҃лїа на оу҆́трени нѣ́сть. А҆́ще же бꙋ́детъ хра́мъ на Собо́ръ Бц҃ы, чте́мъ є҆г҃лїе на оу҆́трени ѿ Мат. зача́ло є҃.] На д҃. пѣ́сни пое́мъ припѣ́въ я҆́кѡже на самы́й пра́здникъ. На славосло́вїи тропа́рь пра́здника. На літꙋргі́и, Блаже́нна ѿ канѡ́на пра́з, пѣ́снь г҃, и҆ ѕ҃. На вхо́дѣ:* Прїиди́те поклони́мся: *и҆* Спаси́ на́съ Сы́не Бж҃їй, рожде́йся, ѿ Дѣ́вы пою́щїя тѝ: а҆ллилꙋ́їа. *Си́це пое́мъ и҆ до ѿда́нїа пра́з. По вхо́дѣ: тропа́рь пра́з, сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ конда́къ,* И҆́же пре́жде денни́цы.
units.english_cohort_translation: [Book Page 163] *feast,* **"Thy Nativity..."** (*Рождество̀ Твоѐ...*). *After the 2nd Trisagion, the kontakion, Tone 6:* **"He that was born before the morning star..."** (*И҆́же пре́жде денни́цы...*); **"Lord, have mercy"** *12 times; and immediately the Dismissal. But the prayer:* **"Remember, O Lord, in the hope..."** (*Помянѝ, Го́споди, въ наде́ждѣ...*) *we do not say. At Matins: at* **"God is the Lord"** (*Бо́гъ Госпо́дь*): *the troparion of the feast, 3 times. [There is no Gospel at Matins. But if it be a temple dedicated to the Synaxis of the Theotokos, we read the Gospel at Matins from Matthew, pericope 5]. At the 9th Ode we sing the refrain as on the feast itself. At the Doxology, the troparion of the feast. At the Divine Liturgy: the Beatitudes from the canon of the feast, Ode 3 and Ode 6. At the Entrance:* **"Come, let us bow down in worship..."**; *and:* **"Save us, O Son of God, Who wast born of the Virgin, who sing to Thee: Alleluia"** (*Спаси́ на́съ, Сы́не Бо́жїй, рожде́йся ѿ Дѣ́вы, пою́щїя Ти: аллилꙋ́їа*). *Thus we sing even until the Apodosis of the feast. units.slavonic_diplomatic: ☞ *подоба́етъ вѣ́дати: Ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́ще слꙋчи́тся рж҃ство̀ Хрⷭ҇то́во въ нл҃ю. Не соверша́емъ па́мяти сты́хъ бг҃оѻтє́цъ въ грядꙋ́щꙋю нл҃ю: зане́же нача́ло прїятѝ і҆анꙋа́рїю мцⷭ҇ꙋ, и҆ пра́з рж҃тва Хрⷭ҇то́ва оу҆же́ ѿдае́тся: но соверша́емъ сїю̀ нл҃ю по рж҃твѣ̀ въ к҃ѕ де́нь деке́мврїа мц҃а на оу҆́трїе пра́здника въ поне́. Тѵ́пикъ къ семꙋ̀ и҆́маши въ трїфологїѡ́нѣ На літꙋргі́и: По вхо́дѣ тропа́рь пра́з и҆ сты́хъ, сла́ва конда́къ сты́хъ, и҆ ны́нѣ Бц҃ы.* И҆же пре́жде денни́цы, *Прокі́менъ Бц҃ы и҆ сты́хъ, та́кожде а҆́пⷭ҇толъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе Бц҃ы и҆ сты́хъ.*
units.english_cohort_translation: ☞ *It is necessary to know: That if the Nativity of Christ occur on a Sunday, we do not celebrate the memory of the Holy God-ancestors on the coming Sunday: because the month of January takes its beginning, and the feast of the Nativity of Christ is already given its Apodosis; but we celebrate this Sunday after the Nativity on the 26th day of the month of December, on the morrow of the feast, on Monday. The Typikon for this thou hast in the Anthologion. At the Divine Liturgy: after the Entrance, troparion of the feast and of the Saints; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:" kontakion of the Saints; "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" of the Theotokos,* **"He that was born before the morning star..."**; *Prokeimenon of the Theotokos and of the Saints; likewise the Epistle and Gospel of the Theotokos and of the Saints.*[^179]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Подоба́етъ вѣ́дати: а҆́ще по рж҃твѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇то́вѣ нл҃я сїя̀ слꙋчи́тся въ к҃ѕ, въ к҃з, въ к҃и, въ к҃ѳ и҆ л҃ де́нь, пое́мъ си́це: На вели́цѣй вече́рни, по каѳі́смѣ, на* Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ: *стїхи̑ры воскрны г҃, и҆ пра́з д҃, и҆ сты́хъ г҃. Сла́ва, гла́съ ѕ҃:* Па́мять соверша́емъ: *и҆ ны́нѣ вг҃оро́ д҃ й гла́са, и҆ про́ч. по* ны́нѣ ѿпꙋща́еши: *тропа́рь воскрнъ, сла́ва сты́хъ, и҆ ны́нѣ пра́з. А҆́ще літі́а и҆ бл҃гослове́нїе хлѣ́бѡвъ бꙋ́детъ: тропа́рь пра́з в҃ и҆ сты́хъ а̄, гла́съ в҃* Благовѣствꙋ́й І҆ѡ́сифе: *На оу҆́трени, на* Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь, *тропа́рь воскрнъ в҃. сла́ва сты́хъ, и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. По ѻ҆бы́чныхъ каѳі́смахъ сѣда́льны воскр. съ вг҃оро́ и҆́хъ. По непоро́чныхъ* А҆́гг҃льскїй собо́ръ, *ѵ҆пакоѝ гла́са, Сте́пенны и҆ прокі́менъ гла́са. Є҆г҃лїе воскрное, и҆* Воскрнїе Хрⷭ҇то́во: *По н҃ Ѱал. стїхи́ра воскрна. Канѡ́нъ воскрнъ съ і҆рмосо́мъ на д҃, и҆ Бц҃ы на д҃ и҆ пра́з на д҃ и҆ бг҃оѻтє́цъ на д҃. [А҆́щеже к҃ѕ. де́нь, пое́мъ кан. воскрнъ на д҃ и҆ пра́з. ѻ҆́ба канѡ́на на ѕ҃ и҆ бг҃оѻтє́цъ на д҃] катава́сїа пра́з. На д҃ пѣ́сни пое́мъ* Честнѣ́йшꙋю *и҆ про́ч. всѐ, я҆́кѡ въ трїфологїѡ́нѣ: На літꙋргі́и, бл҃же́нна гла́са на д҃ и҆ пра́з на д҃ и҆ сты́хъ на д҃, прокі́менъ гла́са и҆ сты́хъ. А҆́пл҃ъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе нл҃и по рж҃твѣ̀, и҆ по то́мъ ря́дъ, а҆́ще не бꙋ́детъ ѿстꙋ́пки.*
units.english_cohort_translation: **Wherein we celebrate the memory of the holy and righteous Joseph the Betrothed, and David the King* It is necessary to know: If after the Nativity of Christ this Sunday occur on the 26th, on the 27th, on the 28th, on the 29th, or on the 30th day, we sing in this manner: At Great Vespers, after the Kathisma, at* **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Го́споди воззва́хъ*): *Sunday Resurrection stichera 3, and of the feast 4, and of the Saints 3. "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit," Tone 6:* **"We celebrate the memory..."** (*Па́мять соверша́емъ...*); *and "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" Theotokion of the 4th Tone; and the rest. After* **"Now lettest Thou"** (*Ны́нѣ ѿпꙋща́еши*): *Sunday Resurrection troparion; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:" of the Saints; "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" of the feast. If Litiya and the blessing of the loaves take place: troparion of the feast 2 times, and of the Saints 1 time, Tone 2:* **"Proclaim the good news, O Joseph..."** (*Благовѣствꙋ́й, І҆ѡ́сифе...*). *At Matins, at* **"God is the Lord"** (*Бо́гъ Госпо́дь*): *Sunday Resurrection troparion 2 times; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:" of the Saints; "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" of the feast. After the customary Kathismata, Sunday Resurrection Sessional Hymns with their Theotokia. After the Amomos [Psalm 118],* **"The angelic council..."** (*А҆́ггельскїй собо́ръ...*); *Hypakoe of the Tone; Graduals and Prokeimenon of the Tone. Sunday Resurrection Gospel, and* **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ..."**; *after Psalm 50, the Sunday Resurrection sticheron. Sunday Resurrection canon with the Heirmos to 4, and of the Theotokos to 4, and of the feast to 4, and of the God-ancestors to 4. [If on the 26th day, we sing the Sunday Resurrection canon to 4, and both canons of the feast to 6, and of the God-ancestors to 4]; Katavasia of the feast. At the 9th Ode we sing* **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**; *and all the rest, as in the Anthologion. At the Divine Liturgy: Beatitudes of the Tone to 4, and of the feast to 4, and of the Saints to 4; Prokeimenon of the Tone and of the Saints. Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday after the Nativity, and thereafter of the cycle, if there be no deferral.*[^180]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Подоба́етъ вѣ́дати: а҆́ще слꙋчи́тся Рж҃тво̀ Хрⷭ҇то́во въ недѣ́лю, и҆ тогда̀ быва́етъ междꙋ̀ рж҃тво́мъ Хрⷭ҇то́вымъ и҆ вг҃оявле́нїемъ є҆ди́на то́кмѡ сꙋббѡ́та и҆ недѣ́ля, и҆ пое́мъ недѣ́лю по рж҃твѣ̀ въ понедѣ́льникъ въ к҃ѕ де́нь Въ ѻ҆́нъже на Літꙋргі́и чте́мъ а҆́пл҃ъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе нл҃ѣ, я҆́же по Рж҃твѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѣ̀: а҆ Сꙋббѡ́тѣ по Рж҃твѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇то́вѣ въ сꙋб: на ѿда́нїе праз Рж҃тва̀ Хрⷭ҇то́ва: та́же сꙋббѡ́тѣ предъ Бг҃оявле́нїемъ. Прокі́менъ же, а҆ллилꙋ́їа и҆ прича́стенъ пра́з. А҆ въ а̄ й І҆анꙋа́рїа прокі́менъ, а҆́птолъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе, чте́мъ нл҃и предъ Бг҃оявле́нїемъ, пото́мъ Ѡ҆брѣ́занїю.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *It is necessary to know: If the Nativity of Christ occur on a Sunday, then there is only a single Saturday and Sunday between the Nativity of Christ and Theophany; and we sing the Sunday after the Nativity on Monday on the 26th day, on which at the Divine Liturgy we read the Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday after the Nativity of Christ; and for the Saturday after the Nativity of Christ on Saturday on the Apodosis of the feast of the Nativity of Christ; thereafter for the Saturday before Theophany. Prokeimenon, Alleluia, and Communion verse of the feast. And on the 1st of January we read the Prokeimenon, Epistle, and Gospel of the Sunday before Theophany, thereafter of the Circumcision.*[^181]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Деке́мврїа въ л҃ де́нь, на літꙋргі́и, Прокі́менъ, а҆́птолъ, а҆ллилꙋ́їа, є҆г҃лїе, и҆ прича́стенъ: пре́жде чте́мъ сꙋббѡ́тѣ, по рж҃твѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇то́вѣ. Та́же а҆́пл҃ъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе сꙋббѡ́тѣ, предъ Бг҃оявле́нїемъ. А҆ нл҃ѣ по рж҃твѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇то́вѣ чте́мъ на літꙋргі́и въ ѿда́нїе праз: рж҃тва̀ Хрⷭ҇то́ва я҆́коже оу҆каза́ся на рядꙋ̀. А҆ недѣ́ли я҆́же предъ Бг҃оявле́нїемъ прокі́менъ, а҆́пл҃ъ, а҆ллилꙋ́їа, и҆ є҆г҃лїе чте́мъ въ а̄ й де́нь І҆анꙋа́рїа, я҆́коже оу҆ка́жется на рядꙋ̀, зрѝ ли́стъ 168.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *Then on December the 30th day, at the Divine Liturgy, Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, Gospel, and Communion verse: first we read for the Saturday after the Nativity of Christ; thereafter the Epistle and Gospel for the Saturday before Theophany. And for the Sunday after the Nativity of Christ we read at the Divine Liturgy on the Apodosis of the feast of the Nativity of Christ, as was indicated in the cycle. And for the Sunday before Theophany, the Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, and Gospel we read on the 1st day of January, as will be indicated in the cycle; see leaf 168.*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: жде субботе по ржтве хртове и по том
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *жде сꙋббѡ́тѣ по рж҃твѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇то́вѣ, и҆ по то́мъ мц҃емъ. А҆ недѣ́ли по рж҃твѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇то́вѣ пое́мъ слꙋ́жбꙋ Деке́мврїа, въ л҃ де́нь, я҆́коже оу҆ка́зъ на рядꙋ̀. А҆ нл҃и предъ Бг҃оявле́нїемъ на літꙋргі́и прокі́менъ а҆́пл҃ъ, а҆ллилꙋ́їа и҆ є҆г҃лїе чте́мъ пре́жде нл҃и предъ Бг҃оявле́нїемъ І҆анꙋа́рїа въ а̄ й де́нь, и҆ по то́мъ Ѡ҆брѣ́занїа и҆ Васи́лїа є҆ди́но.*
units.english_cohort_translation: [Book Page 166] *for the Saturday after the Nativity of Christ, and thereafter for the day of the month. And for the Sunday after the Nativity of Christ we sing the service on December the 30th day, as the directive in the cycle indicates. And for the Sunday before Theophany at the Divine Liturgy, the Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, and Gospel we read first for the Sunday before Theophany on January the 1st day, and thereafter for the Circumcision and Basil together.*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: и тогда бывают между ржтвом и вгоявлением две
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *И҆ тогда̀ быва́ютъ междꙋ̀ рж҃тво́мъ и҆ вг҃оявле́нїемъ двѣ̀ сꙋббѡ́тѣ, и҆ нл҃и: въ а̄ ю оу҆́бѡ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ чте́тся а҆́пл҃ъ сꙋббѡ́тѣ по рж҃твѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇то́вѣ, въ нл҃ю же а҆́пл҃ъ, и҆ є҆г҃лїе нл҃и по рж҃твѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇то́вѣ. А҆ въ в҃ ю сꙋббѡ́тꙋ а҆́пл҃ъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе сꙋббѡ́тѣ предъ Бг҃оявле́нїемъ, въ в҃ ю же нл҃ю чте́тся а҆́пл҃ъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе нл҃и, я҆́же предъ Бг҃оявле́нїемъ, пото́мъ ря́дъ.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *And then there are between the Nativity and Theophany two Saturdays and two Sundays: on the 1st Saturday the Epistle is read for the Saturday after the Nativity of Christ; on the Sunday the Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday after the Nativity of Christ. And on the 2nd Saturday the Epistle and Gospel for the Saturday before Theophany; on the 2nd Sunday the Epistle and Gospel are read for the Sunday before Theophany, thereafter of the cycle.*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Тогда̀ нл҃и я҆́же по рж҃твѣ̀ Хвѣ̀ пое́мъ слꙋ́жбꙋ на оу҆́трїе рж҃тва̀ Хрⷭ҇то́ва въ нл҃ю, я҆́коже оу҆ка́зъ на рядꙋ̀; а҆ ѿда́нїе рождества̀ тогда̀ быва́етъ въ пя́токъ: въ се́й же на літꙋргі́и прокі́менъ а҆ллилꙋ́їа и҆ прича́стенъ пра́здника, а҆́пл҃ъ же и҆ є҆г҃лїе сꙋббѡ́тѣ по рождествѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇то́вѣ. Въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ я҆́же предъ Бг҃оявле́нїемъ на літꙋргі́и: а҆́пл҃ъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе чте́мъ І҆анꙋа́рїа, въ а̄ й день, пре́жде Ѡ҆брѣ́занїа, и҆ по то́мъ сꙋббѡ́тѣ прє̀ Бг҃оявл. А҆ на оу҆́трїе въ настꙋпа́ющꙋю нл҃ю на літꙋргі́и: прок. а҆́пл҃ъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе пре́де нл҃и предъ бг҃оявле́нїемъ: та́же ст҃а́гѡ. Ря́дъ же чте́мъ подъ зача́ло, а҆́ще не бꙋ́дꙋтъ ѿстꙋ́пки.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *Then for the Sunday after the Nativity of Christ we sing the service on the morrow of the Nativity of Christ on Sunday, as the directive in the cycle indicates; and the Apodosis of the Nativity then occurs on Friday: on this day at the Divine Liturgy the Prokeimenon, Alleluia, and Communion verse are of the feast, and the Epistle and Gospel for the Saturday after the Nativity of Christ. On the Saturday before Theophany at the Divine Liturgy: the Epistle and Gospel we read on January the 1st day, first for the Circumcision, and thereafter for the Saturday before Theophany. And on the morrow on the oncoming Sunday at the Divine Liturgy: Prokeimenon, Epistle, and Gospel first for the Sunday before Theophany; thereafter of the Saint. The cycle we read under the pericope, if there be no deferrals.*[^182]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ☞ *А҆́ще є҆́сть хра́мъ ст҃а́гѡ Стефа́на, быва́етъ бдѣ́нїе, прпⷡбнагѡ же слꙋ́жба пое́тся на повече́рїи. И҆ пое́мъ всю̀ слꙋ́жбꙋ ст҃а́гѡ Стефа́на, ве́черъ и҆ оу҆́тро, я҆́кѡже бдѣ́ннагѡ ст҃а́гѡ прилꙋча́ющагѡся въ попра́зднство. На оу҆́трїе Полѷеле́й и҆ велича́нїе ст҃а́гѡ. Сте́пенна а̄ й а҆нтїфѡ́нъ г҃ гѡ гла́са. Прокі́менъ ст҃а́гѡ, є҆г҃лїе ѿ І҆ѡа́нна зач. н҃в. и҆ про́ч.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *In the evening, customary Kathisma. At* **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Го́споди воззва́хъ*): *stichera of Stephen 3, and of the Venerable 3; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:" of Stephen; "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" of the feast. The Entrance. Prokeimenon of the day, and the rest, as in the Anthologion.*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ☞ *А҆́ще слꙋчи́тся хра́мъ ст҃а́гѡ Стефа́на въ нл҃ю по рж҃твѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇то́вѣ. На ма́лѣй вече́рни стїхи̑ры воскрны и҆ хра́ма по ѻ҆бы́чаю.
units.english_cohort_translation: ☞ *If it be a temple dedicated to St. Stephen, an All-Night Vigil takes place; but the service of the Venerable is sung at Compline. And we sing the entire service of St. Stephen, evening and morning, as for a saint with a vigil occurring in the afterfeast. At Matins: Polyeleos and Megalynarion of the Saint; Graduals the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4 [Tone 3]; Prokeimenon of the Saint; Gospel from John, pericope 52; and the rest.*
units.slavonic_text: ☞ *А҆́ще слꙋчи́тся хра́мъ ст҃а́гѡ Стефа́на въ нл҃ю по рж҃твѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇то́вѣ. На ма́лѣй вече́рни стїхи̑ры воскрны и҆ хра́ма по ѻ҆бы́чаю.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *кі́менъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе хра́ма.* Воскрнїе Хрⷭ҇то́во: *И҆ стїхи́ра хра́ма. Канѡ́нъ воскрнъ со і҆рм. на д҃, и҆ сты́хъ на д҃, и҆ Стефа́на на ѕ҃. Катава́сїа пра́здника. По г҃ й пѣ́сни конда́къ сты́хъ и҆ і҆́косъ, и҆ сѣда́л. хра́ма сла́ва сты́хъ, и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. По ѕ҃ пѣ́сни конда́къ и҆ і҆́косъ хра́ма. На ѳ҃ й пѣ́сни пое́мъ* Честнѣ́йшꙋю. *На хвали́техъ стїхи̑ры воскрны д҃, и҆ хра́ма съ припѣ́вы д҃, сла́ва хра́ма, и҆ ны́нѣ* Пребл҃гослове́нна є҆сѝ, *и҆ про́ч. На літꙋргі́и тропа́рь воскрнъ: пра́здника, и҆ а҆́пл҃а. А҆́пл҃ъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе нл҃и по рж҃твѣ̀, и҆ а҆́пл҃а Стефа́на.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *-keimenon and Gospel of the temple;* **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ..."**; *and sticheron of the temple. Sunday Resurrection canon with the Heirmos to 4, and of the Saints to 4, and of Stephen to 6; Katavasia of the feast. After Ode 3, kontakion of the Saints and Ikos, and Sessional Hymn of the temple; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:" of the Saints; "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" of the feast. After Ode 6, kontakion and Ikos of the temple. At Ode 9 we sing* **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**. *At the Praises, Sunday Resurrection stichera 4, and of the temple with refrains 4; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:" of the temple; "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:"* **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos..."** (*Преблагослове́нна є҆сѝ...*); *and the rest. At the Divine Liturgy: Sunday Resurrection troparion; of the feast; and of the Apostle. At Little Vespers, Sunday Resurrection stichera according to custom. At Great Vespers, at* **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Го́споди воззва́хъ*): *we sing Sunday Resurrection stichera 3, and of the feast 3, and of the Saint to 4; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:" of the Saint; "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. The Entrance; and 3 readings. At the Litiya, sticheron of the temple, and of St. Basil. At the Aposticha, stichera of the Octoechos; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:" of the Saint; "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" of the feast. At the blessing of the loaves, troparion* **"O Theotokos Virgin..."** *2 times, of the Saint 1 time. At Matins, the Polyeleos; Graduals of the Tone; Sunday Resurrection Gospel; and the rest. At the Divine Liturgy, after the Entrance: Sunday Resurrection troparion, and of the feast,*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Подоба́етъ вѣ́дати: а҆́ще слꙋчи́тся ѡ҆брѣ́занїе Гдⷭ҇не, и҆ ст҃а́гѡ Васи́лїа вели́кагѡ въ нл҃ю, твори́мъ бдѣ́нїе. На ма́лѣй вече́рни ср҃ы воскрны по ѻ҆бы́чаю. На вели́цѣй вече́рни, на* Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ, *пое́мъ стїхи̑ры воскрны г҃, и҆ пра́з г҃, и҆ ст҃а́гѡ на д҃, сла́ва ст҃а́гѡ, и҆ ны́нѣ догма́тъ гла́са, Вхо́дъ. И҆ чте́нїа г҃. На літі́и стїхи̑ра хра́ма, и҆ ст҃а́гѡ Васи́лїа. На стїхо́внѣ стїхи̑ры ѻ҆ктѡ́иха, сла́ва ст҃агѡ, и҆ ны́нѣ пра́з. На бл҃гослове́нїи хлѣ́бѡвъ тропа́рь* Бц҃е Дв҃о *в҃, ст҃а́гѡ а̄. На оу҆́трени полѷеле́й. Степе́нна гла́са, Є҆г҃лїе воскрное, и҆ про́чяя. На літꙋргі́и, По вхо́дѣ, тропа́рь воскрнъ, и҆ пра́з-* --- Page 169 --- *дника, и҆ ст҃а́гѡ, сла́ва конда́къ ст҃а́гѡ, и҆ ны́нѣ пра́з. Прокі́менъ нл҃и прѐ просвѣще́нїемъ, и҆ ст҃а́гѡ. А҆́пл҃ъ нл҃я предъ просвѣще́нїемъ, дрꙋгі́й а҆́пл҃ъ, ко Колоса́емъ зач. сп҃д. и҆ ст҃а́гѡ. Є҆г҃лїе нл҃я предъ просвѣще́нїемъ. И҆ Ѡ҆брѣ́занїа и҆ Васи́лїа. Літꙋргі́а Васи́лїа вели́кагѡ. За досто́йнѡ,* ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ ра́дꙋетсѧ.

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Послѣ́дованїе часѡ́въ цр҃кихъ въ навече́рїи вг҃оявле́нїа и҆лѝ просвѣще́нїа быва́етъ по оу҆ка́зꙋ, зрѝ деке́мврїа въ к҃д де́нь, на ли́стѣ 157. По часѣ́хъ быва́етъ расхо́дъ до часа̀ ѕ҃ днѐ. Вече́рна же быва́етъ съ літꙋргі́ею Васи́лїа вели́кагѡ во свое́ вре́мя. И҆ по заамво́нной моли́твѣ, а҆́бїе и҆схо́димъ всѝ ко ѡ҆сщ҃е́нїю воды̀ въ притво́ръ [и҆лѝ на и҆сто́чники] цр҃кви браты̀. Старѣ́йшїй і҆ере́й, а҆́ще мно́зи бꙋ́дꙋтъ, нося́й на главѣ̀ чт҃ны́й крⷭ҇тъ, предидꙋ́щымъ є҆мꙋ̀ свѣщеносцемъ и҆ дїа́кономъ съ кади̑лы. И҆ полага́етъ чт҃ны́й крⷭ҇тъ на оу҆краше́нномъ столѣ̀, и҆дѣ́же и҆ водѣ̀ оу҆гото́ванѣ въ ча́шѣ и҆ свѣща́мъ ѻ҆́крестъ стоя́щымъ, и҆ даю́тся свѣщы̀ бра́тїямъ. Ли́кѡмъ же пою́щымъ, тропарѝ, гла́съ и҃:* Гла́съ Гдⷭ҇ень на вода́хъ, *г҃. Въ то́же вре́мя настоя́тель кади́тъ ѻ҆́крестъ стола̀, ѡ҆бразы̀ и҆ лю́ди по чи́нꙋ, предходя́щꙋ є҆мꙋ̀ дїа́конꙋ со свѣще́ю. И҆ быва́етъ ѡ҆сщ҃е́нїе воды̀, я҆́кѡже въ тре́бникꙋ и҆ трифологїѡ́нѣ оу҆каза́ся. Гле́мѣй є҆кте́нїи ѡ҆сщ҃е́нїа ѿ дїа́кона, і҆ере́й*
units.english_cohort_translation: **On the 5th Day: The Eve of the Theophany of the Lord* The order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of Theophany or Illumination takes place according to the directive; see December the 24th day, on leaf 157. After the Hours, the departure takes place until the 6th hour of the day. Vespers takes place with the Divine Liturgy of Basil the Great at its proper time. And after the Ambo Prayer, immediately we all go forth to the blessing of water into the narthex [or to the springs/rivers] of the church with the brethren. The senior priest, if there be many, bearing upon his head the Precious Cross, preceded by candle-bearers and the deacon with the censer. And he places the Precious Cross upon a decorated table, where water is also prepared in a basin with candles standing round about, and candles are distributed to the brethren. While the choirs sing the troparia, Tone 8:* **"The voice of the Lord upon the waters..."** (*Гла́съ Госпо́день на вода́хъ...*) *3 times. At that same time the Superior censes round about the table, the icons, and the people in order, preceded by the deacon with a candle. And the blessing of water takes place, as indicated in the Trebnik and Anthologion. While the ectene of blessing is said by the deacon, the priest*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: глет млтву гди иисе хрт единородный сыне втай
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *гле́тъ млт҃вꙋ:* Гдⷭ҇и І҆и҃се Хрⷭ҇тѐ є҆диноро́дный сы́не: *вта́й, безъ возгла́са, и҆ а҆́бїе начина́етъ ве́лїимъ гла́сомъ, во оу҆слы́шанїе всѣ́хъ моли́твꙋ сїю̀ гла́:* Ве́лїй є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ чꙋ́днаѧ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑. *(Моли́тва же* Трⷪцы пресꙋ́щественна: *не ѡ҆брѣта́ется въ дре́вныхъ тре́бницѣхъ). По ѡ҆сщ҃е́нїи воды̀ ѡ҆бра́щся і҆ере́й на за́падъ лице́мъ: Въ лѣ́вой рꙋцѣ́ держа̀ честны́й крⷭ҇тъ, а҆ въ пра́вой васі́лки [кропи́лце] кро́питъ крⷭ҇тоѡбра́знѡ на вся̑ страны̀, и҆ цѣлꙋ́ютъ всѝ чт҃ны́й крⷭ҇тъ. Пое́тся же тогда̀ тропа́рь ѿ всѣ́хъ мно́гады. Вхо́димъ въ хра́мъ, и҆ пое́мъ стїхи̑ры, сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ ѕ҃* Воспои́мъ вѣ́рнїи: *та́же* Бꙋ́ди и҆́мя Гдⷭ҇не *г҃,* ѱало́мъ л҃г. *Пото́мъ дае́тся а҆нтї́дѡръ ѿ і҆ере́а и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. По ѿпꙋ́стѣ тропа́рь и҆ конда́къ средѝ цр҃кве. И҆ вхо́димъ въ тра́пезꙋ, и҆ я҆ди́мъ съ древянома́слїемъ.*
units.english_cohort_translation: [Book Page 170] *says the prayer:* **"O Lord Jesus Christ, Only-begotten Son..."** (*Го́споди І҆исоу́се Христѐ, Е҆диноро́дный Сы́не...*) *secretly, without exclamation; and immediately begins in a loud voice, in the hearing of all, saying this prayer:* **"Great art Thou, O Lord, and marvelous are Thy works..."** (*Ве́лїй є҆сѝ, Го́споди, и҆ чꙋ́дна дѣла̀ Твоя̑...*). *(The prayer* **"O Transubstantial Trinity"** *is not found in the ancient Trebniks). After the blessing of water, the priest turning his face toward the west: holding in his left hand the Precious Cross, and in his right the basil [sprinkler], sprinkles crosswise in all directions, and all kiss the Precious Cross. At that time the troparion is sung by all many times. We enter into the church, and sing the stichera; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:", Tone 6:* **"Let us sing, O believers..."** (*Воспои́мъ, вѣ́рнїи...*); *then:* **"Blessed be the name of the Lord..."** *3 times; Psalm 33 [Psalm 34]. Then antidoron is distributed by the priest, and the Dismissal. After the Dismissal, troparion and kontakion in the midst of the church. And we enter into the refectory, and eat with oil.*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ☞ *А҆́ще же слꙋчи́тся навече́рїе ст҃а́гѡ вг҃оявле́нїа въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ и҆лѝ нл҃ю, по́стъ не быва́етъ. Часы̀ цр҃кїа пою́тся пре́жде въ пя́токъ. Въ навече́рїи же (а҆́ще въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ и҆лѝ нл҃ю бꙋ́детъ) літꙋргі́а быва́етъ златоꙋ́стагѡ во свое́ вре́мя по ѻ҆бы́чаю, я҆́коже и҆ всегда̀ по рядꙋ̀. И҆ по ѿпꙋще́нїи літꙋргі́и въ тра́пезꙋ не вхо́димъ, но вкꙋ́сше что̀ ма́лѡ оу҆тѣ́ха, ѡ҆жида́емъ вече́рнагѡ собо́ра.*
units.english_cohort_translation: ☞ *If the Eve of Holy Theophany occur on a Saturday or Sunday, there is no fast. The Royal Hours are sung beforehand on Friday. On the Eve (if it be on a Saturday or Sunday), the Divine Liturgy of Chrysostom takes place at its proper time according to custom, as always in order. And after the dismissal of the Divine Liturgy we do not enter into the refectory, but tasting a little refreshment, we await the evening assembly.*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: при часе же вечернем дне знаменает в кампан
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *При часѣ́ же вече́рнемъ днѐ: Зна́менаетъ въ кампа́нъ и҆ ко вся̑, и҆ со́бравшымся во хра́мъ, пое́мъ* --- Page 171 --- *вече́рню по ѻ҆бы́чаю.* Блаже́нъ мꙋ́жъ: *на* Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ: *ста́вимъ стїхѡ́въ и҃, и҆ пое́мъ стїхи̑ры пра́здника гла́съ в҃.* Просвѣти́теля на́шегѡ: *Та́же вхо́ со є҆г҃лїемъ. Прокі́менъ днѐ, и҆ чте́нїа по чи́нꙋ и҆́хъ со тропарѝ и҆ со стїхѝ и҆́хъ. [Трїсто́е не пое́мъ, зане́ же не соверша́ется бж҃твеннаѧ літꙋргі́а] По чте́нїи же парамі́й, є҆кте́нїа ма́лаѧ: и҆ по возгла́сѣ, Прокі́менъ, А҆́пл҃ъ и҆ Є҆г҃лїе я҆́кѡ предписа́ся. Є҆кте́нїа:* Рце́мъ всѝ: Сподо́би Гдⷭ҇и: И҆спо́лнимъ вече́рна моли́твы. *І҆ере́й возгла́съ. (Стїхо́вной нѣ́ст). И҆ и҆схо́димъ а҆́бїе [предъ ѿпꙋсто́мъ] ко крⷭ҇ти́лници на ѡ҆сщ҃е́нїе воды̀ въ притво́ръ, и҆дѣ́же оу҆гото́ванъ сто́лъ. И҆ дѣ́йствꙋетъ і҆ере́й по чи́нꙋ, я҆́кѡже оу҆каза́ся пре́жде, пою́ще:* Гла́съ Гдⷭ҇нь на вода́хъ. *И҆ про́чее быва́етъ ѡ҆сщ҃е́нїе воды̀ неизмѣ́ннѡ. По кропле́нїи же сщ҃е́нныя воды̀, вхо́димъ въ хра́мъ. И҆ пое́мъ стїхи́рꙋ, сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ гла́съ ѕ҃:* Воспои́мъ вѣ́рныи. *И҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ вече́рни. И҆ пото́мъ средѝ цр҃кве, тропа́рь пра́здника, сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ конда́къ. И҆ пи́вше сщ҃е́ннꙋю во́дꙋ вхо́димъ въ трапе́зꙋ, и҆ я҆ди́мъ соверше́ннѡ съ древянома́слїемъ.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *Vespers according to custom.* **"Blessed is the man"** (*Блаже́нъ мꙋ́жъ*); *at* **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Го́споди воззва́хъ*): *we set 8 stichera, and sing stichera of the feast, Tone 2:* **"Our Enlightener..."** (*Просвѣти́теля на́шегѡ...*). *Then the Entrance with the Gospel. Prokeimenon of the day, and the readings in their order with the troparia and with their verses. [The Trisagion we do not sing, because the Divine Liturgy is not celebrated]. After the reading of the Paremias, the Little Ectene; and after the exclamation, Prokeimenon, Epistle, and Gospel as prescribed above. Ectene:* **"Let us all say..."**; **"Vouchsafe, O Lord..."**; **"Let us complete our evening prayer..."**; *the priest says the exclamation. (There are no Aposticha). And we go forth immediately [before the dismissal] to the font for the blessing of water into the narthex, where a table is prepared. And the priest acts according to the rite, as was indicated before, while we sing:* **"The voice of the Lord upon the waters..."** *And the rest of the blessing of water takes place invariably. After the sprinkling of the holy water, we enter into the church. And we sing the sticheron; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:", Tone 6:* **"Let us sing, O believers..."** *And the Dismissal of Vespers. And thereafter in the midst of the church, the troparion of the feast; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" the kontakion. And having drunk the holy water, we enter into the refectory, and eat fully with oil.*
units.slavonic_text: *При часѣ́ же вече́рнемъ днѐ: Зна́менаетъ въ кампа́нъ и҆ ко вся̑, и҆ со́бравшымся во хра́мъ, пое́мъ* --- Page 171 --- *вече́рню по ѻ҆бы́чаю.* Блаже́нъ мꙋ́жъ: *на* Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ: *ста́вимъ стїхѡ́въ и҃, и҆ пое́мъ стїхи̑ры пра́здника гла́съ в҃.* Просвѣти́теля на́шегѡ: *Та́же вхо́ со є҆г҃лїемъ. Прокі́менъ днѐ, и҆ чте́нїа по чи́нꙋ и҆́хъ со тропарѝ и҆ со стїхѝ и҆́хъ. [Трїсто́е не пое́мъ, зане́ же не соверша́ется бж҃твеннаѧ літꙋргі́а] По чте́нїи же парамі́й, є҆кте́нїа ма́лаѧ: и҆ по возгла́сѣ, Прокі́менъ, А҆́пл҃ъ и҆ Є҆г҃лїе я҆́кѡ предписа́ся. Є҆кте́нїа:* Рце́мъ всѝ: Сподо́би Гдⷭ҇и: И҆спо́лнимъ вече́рна моли́твы. *І҆ере́й возгла́съ. (Стїхо́вной нѣ́ст). И҆ и҆схо́димъ а҆́бїе [предъ ѿпꙋсто́мъ] ко крⷭ҇ти́лници на ѡ҆сщ҃е́нїе воды̀ въ притво́ръ, и҆дѣ́же оу҆гото́ванъ сто́лъ. И҆ дѣ́йствꙋетъ і҆ере́й по чи́нꙋ, я҆́кѡже оу҆каза́ся пре́жде, пою́ще:* Гла́съ Гдⷭ҇нь на вода́хъ. *И҆ про́чее быва́етъ ѡ҆сщ҃е́нїе воды̀ неизмѣ́ннѡ. По кропле́нїи же сщ҃е́нныя воды̀, вхо́димъ въ хра́мъ. И҆ пое́мъ стїхи́рꙋ, сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ гла́съ ѕ҃:* Воспои́мъ вѣ́рныи. *И҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ вече́рни. И҆ пото́мъ средѝ цр҃кве, тропа́рь пра́здника, сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ конда́къ. И҆ пи́вше сщ҃е́ннꙋю во́дꙋ вхо́димъ въ трапе́зꙋ, и҆ я҆ди́мъ соверше́ннѡ съ древянома́слїемъ.*
units.english_text: *Vespers according to custom.* **"Blessed is the man"** (*Блаже́нъ мꙋ́жъ*); *at* **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Го́споди воззва́хъ*): *we set 8 stichera, and sing stichera of the feast, Tone 2:* **"Our Enlightener..."** (*Просвѣти́теля на́шегѡ...*). *Then the Entrance with the Gospel. Prokeimenon of the day, and the readings in their order with the troparia and with their verses. [The Trisagion we do not sing, because the Divine Liturgy is not celebrated]. After the reading of the Paremias, the Little Ectene; and after the exclamation, Prokeimenon, Epistle, and Gospel as prescribed above. Ectene:* **"Let us all say..."**; **"Vouchsafe, O Lord..."**; **"Let us complete our evening prayer..."**; *the priest says the exclamation. (There are no Aposticha). And we go forth immediately [before the dismissal] to the font for the blessing of water into the narthex, where a table is prepared. And the priest acts according to the rite, as was indicated before, while we sing:* **"The voice of the Lord upon the waters..."** *And the rest of the blessing of water takes place invariably. After the sprinkling of the holy water, we enter into the church. And we sing the sticheron; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:", Tone 6:* **"Let us sing, O believers..."** *And the Dismissal of Vespers. And thereafter in the midst of the church, the troparion of the feast; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" the kontakion. And having drunk the holy water, we enter into the refectory, and eat fully with oil.*

units.english_cohort_translation: *On whatever day it may occur, Great Compline is sung after midnight in this manner: At the 10th hour of the night, the bell strikes the great bell, and thereafter all the bells. And having assembled in church, the priest having blessed and censed, we sing Great Compline with Litiya, as was indicated on December the 24th day on leaf 160. And* **"God is with us"** *with singing, in Tone 8. After the 1st Trisagion, troparion of the feast:* **"When Thou wast baptized in the Jordan..."** (*Во І҆орда́нѣ...*). *After the 2nd Trisagion, kontakion of the feast:* **"Thou hast appeared today..."** (*Ꙗ҆ви́лся є҆сѝ...*). *After "Glory to God in the highest", the Litiya takes place into the narthex of the church according to custom: while we sing the stichera of the feast, Tone 4:* **"He that clothes Himself with light as with a garment..."** (*Ѡ҆дѣва́йся свѣ́томъ, я҆́кѡ ри́зою...*). *Then after the stichera, the prayers of the Litiya:* **"Save, O God, Thy people..."** *And having entered into the church, we sing the Aposticha of the feast with its refrains. At the blessing of the loaves, troparion of the feast 3 times.* **"Blessed be the name of the Lord..."** *3 times with singing; Psalm 33 [Psalm 34]. And the reading of the feast is set forth; and after the reading immediately:* **"Glory to God in the highest..."**; *the Six Psalms, and the rest of Matins, as on all great feasts. On this day the Divine Liturgy takes place early, because of the labor of the vigil. At the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons of the feast. Instead of the Trisagion, we sing:* **"As many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ. Alleluia"** (*Е҆ли́цы во Хрїста̀ крести́стеся, во Хрїста̀ ѡ҆блеко́стеся. А҆ллилꙋ́їа*); *and the rest.*[^187]

units.slavonic_incipit: лꙋнощи повече́рїе вели́кое: си́це: При часѣ́
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: лунощи повечерие великое сице при часе и нощи
units.slavonic_diplomatic: лꙋнощи повече́рїе вели́кое: си́це: При часѣ́ і҃ но́щи, оу҆даря́етъ въ вели́кїй, пото́мъ во вся̑ кампа́ны. И҆ со́бравшымся во хра́мъ, бл҃гослови́вшꙋ и҆ кади́вшꙋ і҆ере́ю, пое́мъ повече́рїе вели́кое съ літі́ею, я҆́кѡже к҃д гѡ Деке́мврїа на листѣ̀ 160 оу҆каза́ся. И҆ съ на́ми Бг҃ъ съ пѣ́нїемъ, на гла́съ и҃. По г҃ мъ трїсто́мъ тропа́рь пра́зка: Во І҆ѡрда́нѣ: По в҃ мъ трїсто́мъ конда́къ пра́зника, Ꙗ҆ви́лся є҆сѝ: По, сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ, по ѻ҆бы́чаю быва́етъ літі́а въ притво́ръ це́ркве: пою́щымъ на́мъ стїхи̑ры пра́здника гла́съ д҃. Ѡ҆дѣва́йся свѣ́томъ, я҆́кѡ ри́зою: Та́же по стїхи́рахъ мл҃твы літі́йныя: Сп҃сѝ Бж҃е люди твоѧ̑. И҆ вше́дше въ хра́мъ, пое́мъ стїхо́внꙋ пра́здника съ припѣ̑вы є҆гѡ̀. На бл҃гослове́нїи хлѣ́бѡвъ, тропа́рь пра́з г҃. Бꙋ́ди и҆́мя Гдⷭ҇не г҃, съ пѣ́нїемъ, Ѱало́мъ л҃г. И҆ предложи́тся чте́нїе пра́з. и҆ по чте́нїи а҆́бїе: Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ Бг҃ꙋ: Шестоѱа́лмїе, и҆ про́чее оу҆́трени, я҆́коже во вся̑ пра́здниквныи. Въ се́й де́нь літꙋргі́а быва́етъ по ра́нꙋ трꙋда̀ ра́ди бдѣ́ннагѡ. На літꙋргі́и, а҆нтї́фѡны пра́здника. Вмѣ́сто трїста́гѡ, пое́мъ: Є҆ли́цы во Хрⷭ҇та̀ крⷭ҇ти́стеся: и҆ про́ч.
units.english_cohort_translation: *Forerunner 3. The Entrance; Great Prokeimenon. At the Divine Liturgy: Beatitudes from the canon of the feast, Ode 3; and of the Forerunner, Ode 4 to 4. After the Entrance, troparion of the feast and of the Forerunner; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:" kontakion of the Forerunner; "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" of the feast. Entrance response:* **"Save us, O Son of God, Who wast baptized in the Jordan by John, who sing to Thee: Alleluia"** (*Спасѝ на́съ, Сы́не Бо́жїй, во І҆орда́нѣ крести́выйся ѿ І҆ѡа́нна, пою́щыя Ти: аллилꙋ́їа*). *Thus we sing even until the Apodosis. Prokeimenon and Communion verse of the feast and of the Saint; Epistle and Gospel of the Saint.*[^188]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Ве́черъ стїхоло́гїа не быва́етъ, кромѣ̀ сꙋббѡ́ты. На* Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ, *стїхи̑ры пра́з г҃, и҆ ст҃а́-* --- Page 173 --- *гѡ г҃. Вхо́дъ Прокі́менъ вели́кїй. На літꙋргі́и, Блаже́нна ѿ канѡ́на пра́здника пѣ́снь г҃. И҆ пре́течи пѣ́снь д҃ на д҃. По вхо́дѣ тропа́рь пра́з и҆ предте́чи, сла́ва конда́къ пре́течи, и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. Вхо́дъ:* Спасѝ на́съ сн҃е Бж҃їй во І҆ѡрда́ни кр҃ти́выйся пою́щыя тѝ: а҆ллилꙋ́їа. *Си́це пое́мъ и҆ до ѿда́нїа. Прокі́менъ и҆ прича́стенъ пра́здника и҆ ст҃а́гѡ, а҆́пл҃ъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе ст҃а́гѡ.*
units.english_cohort_translation: **The Saturday after Theophany* Prokeimenon, Tone 8:* **"Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous"** (*Весели́теся ѡ҆ Го́сподѣ, и҆ ра́дꙋйтеся, пра́веднїи*). *Epistle to the Ephesians, pericope 233. Gospel from Matthew, pericope 7. Communion verse of the feast; another:* **"Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous"** (*Ра́дꙋйтеся, пра́веднїи, ѡ҆ Го́сподѣ*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ☞ *Подоба́етъ вѣ́дати: А҆́ще слꙋчи́тся собо́р пре́течи въ сꙋб: А҆́пл҃ъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе чте́тся пре́жде сꙋббѡ́тѣ по просвѣще́нїи, пото́мъ пре́течи. Прича́стенъ пра́здника, дрꙋгі́й: Въ па́мять вѣ́чнꙋю. Си́це пое́мъ на літꙋргі́и въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ, и҆ сты́мъ и҆мꙋ́щымъ літꙋргі́ю.*
units.english_cohort_translation: ☞ *It is necessary to know: If the Synaxis of the Forerunner occur on a Saturday: the Epistle and Gospel are read first for the Saturday after Theophany, then of the Forerunner. Communion verse of the feast; another:* **"In everlasting remembrance shall the righteous be"** (*Въ па́мять вѣ́чнꙋю бꙋ́детъ пра́ведникъ*). *Thus we sing at the Divine Liturgy on Saturday, and for saints having a Liturgy.*[^189]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *На літꙋргі́и прокі́менъ: гла́съ а̄:* Бꙋ́ди Гдⷭ҇и млⷭ҇ть твоя̀ на на́съ, я҆́коже оу҆пова́хомъ на тя̀. *И҆ пра́здника. А҆́ще же слꙋчи́тся ст҃ый и҆мѣ́ай на літꙋргі́и прокі́менъ и҆ а҆́птолъ, и҆ є҆г҃лїе: Тогда̀ пра́з. прокі́менъ и҆ прича́стенъ ѡ҆ставля́ется. А҆́пл҃ъ ко Є҆фесі́емъ зач. ск҃д. ѿ полꙋ̀. Є҆г҃лїе Мат. зач. и҆.* Слы́шавъ І҆и҃съ: *Прича́стенъ пра́здника. Дрꙋгі́й* Хвали́те.
units.english_cohort_translation: *At the Divine Liturgy, Prokeimenon, Tone 1:* **"Let Thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, according as we have hoped in Thee"** (*Бꙋ́ди, Го́споди, ми́лость Твоя̀ на на́съ, я҆́коже оу҆пова́хомъ на Тя̀*); *and of the feast. But if a saint occur who hath at the Divine Liturgy a Prokeimenon, Epistle, and Gospel: then the festal Prokeimenon and Communion verse are omitted. Epistle to the Ephesians, pericope 224 from the midpoint. Gospel from Matthew, pericope 8:* **"When Jesus heard..."** (*Слы́шавъ І҆исоу́съ...*). *Communion verse of the feast; another:* **"Praise the Lord from the heavens..."** (*Хвали́те Го́спода съ небе́съ...*).

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ☞ *Здѣ̀ внима́й, ко́ю нл҃ю по а̄ й нл҃и по просвѣще́нїи и҆́маши воспрїи́мати, по ключа́мъ, и҆́хже на предѝ положи́хомъ. А҆́ще же когда̀ преизы́детъ недѣ́ль си́хъ, ѡ҆ста́вивъ и҆зли́щныя, блюдѝ ря́дъ ѿ мытаря̀ и҆ фарисе́я. Недѣ́ля же ѡ҆ Закхе́и всегда̀ неразлꙋ́чнѡ чте́тся пре́жде недѣ́ли ѡ҆ Мытарѝ и҆ Фарисе́и.*
units.english_cohort_translation: ☞ *Here pay heed: Which Sunday after the 1st Sunday after Theophany thou shalt resume, according to the Keys which we set forth above. If ever there be a surplus of these Sundays, leaving aside the superfluous ones, observe the cycle from the Publican and Pharisee. The Sunday of Zacchaeus is always invariably read before the Sunday of the Publican and Pharisee.*[^190]

units.slavonic_incipit: А҆́ще слꙋчи́тся трїе́хъ ст҃и́телей въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: аще случится триех стителей в субботу мясопустную поем
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Подоба́етъ вѣ́дати: А҆́ще слꙋчи́тся трїе́хъ ст҃и́телей въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ мясопꙋ́стнꙋю: пое́мъ слꙋ́жбꙋ и҆́хъ въ пато́къ пре́жде во все́мъ непремѣ́ннѡ. Но а҆́ще є҆́сть и҆́хъ хра́мъ, слꙋ́жба оу҆ме́ршихъ пое́мъ ве́черъ оу҆́тро въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ мимоше́дшꙋю. Въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ же слꙋ́жба вся̀ пра́здника є҆ди́нагѡ пое́тся непремѣ́ннѡ.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *It is necessary to know: If the Three Hierarchs occur on Meatfare Saturday: we sing their service on Friday beforehand in all respects invariably. But if it be their temple feast, the service of the reposed is sung evening and morning on the preceding Saturday. And on Saturday the entire service of the feast alone is sung invariably.*[^191]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Подоба́етъ вѣ́дати: а҆́ще слꙋчи́тся пра́здникъ Срѣ́тенїа гдⷭ҇ня въ недѣ́лю Мытаря̀ и҆ Фарисе́я, и҆лѝ блꙋ́днагѡ, и҆лѝ мясопꙋ́стнꙋю, и҆лѝ сыропꙋ́стнꙋю: зрѝ оу҆ка́зъ въ Трїѡ́ди. Тропарѝ же и҆ кондакѝ гле́мъ си́це: По* ны́нѣ ѿпꙋща́еши, *тропа́рь воскрнъ, сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ пра́з. На повече́рїи, по трїсто́мъ конда́къ трїѡ́ди сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *It is necessary to know: If the feast of the Meeting of the Lord occur on the Sunday of the Publican and Pharisee, or of the Prodigal Son, or Meatfare, or Cheesefare: see the directive in the Triodion. But the troparia and kontakia we say in this manner: After* **"Now lettest Thou"** (*Ны́нѣ ѿпꙋща́еши*): *Sunday Resurrection troparion; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" of the feast. At Compline, after the Trisagion, kontakion of the Triodion; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" of the feast.*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: ащели случится праз сретениа в кой ден сырныя
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *А҆́щели слꙋчи́тся пра́з срѣ́тенїа въ ко́й де́нь сы́рныя нл҃и, соверша́ется вся̀ слꙋ́жба пра́здника: Поне́же трїѡ́дь съ пра́зкомъ не пое́тся, кромѣ̀ сꙋббѡ́ты и҆ нл҃и. Въ средꙋ же и҆ пато́къ сыропꙋ́стный, а҆́ще въ ты́я Срѣ́тенїе гдⷭ҇не слꙋчи́тся, на коне́цъ вече́рни и҆ оу҆́тренни и҆ вся́кагѡ часа̀ быва́етъ по г҃ покло́ны вели́кїа. Літꙋргі́а же златоꙋ́стагѡ соверша́ется во свое́ вре́мя.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *If the feast of the Meeting occur on any day of Cheesefare Week, the entire service of the feast is celebrated: because the Triodion is not sung with the feast, except on Saturday and Sunday. But on Cheesefare Wednesday and Friday, if the Meeting of the Lord occur on them, at the end of Vespers and Matins and of every Hour there are 3 great prostrations. And the Divine Liturgy of Chrysostom is celebrated at its proper time.*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *А҆́ще слꙋчи́тся ѡ҆брѣ́тенїе чт҃ны́я главы̀ І҆ѡа́нна пре́течи въ Сꙋббѡ́тꙋ мясопꙋ́стнꙋю: Пое́тся пра́здникъ предте́чевъ ве́сь, пре́жде въ пато́къ мясопꙋ́стный непремѣ́ннѡ. Та́кожде, а҆́щели слꙋ-*
units.english_cohort_translation: *If the Finding of the Precious Head of John the Forerunner occur on Meatfare Saturday: the entire feast of the Forerunner is sung beforehand on Meatfare Friday invariably. units.slavonic_diplomatic: ☞ *А҆́щели слꙋчи́тся ѡ҆брѣ́тенїе чт҃ныѧ главы̀ прⷭ҇дте́чи, Въ понедѣ́льникъ в҃ я, и҆лѝ г҃ я, и҆лѝ д҃ я нл҃и постѡ́въ.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *On Sunday evening we sing:* **"Blessed is the man"** (*Блаже́нъ мꙋ́жъ*), *the 1st Antiphon; at* **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Го́споди воззва́хъ*): *stichera to 10: of the Triodion of the day to 4, repeating the 1st; and of the Forerunner to 6; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:" of the Forerunner; "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" Dogmatic Theotokion. The Entrance; Great Prokeimenon of the Triodion; and 3 readings of the Forerunner. Immediately the church doors are closed. Then:* **"Vouchsafe, O Lord, to keep us this night..."** (*Сподо́би, Го́споди, въ ве́черъ се́й...*). *The priest before the Royal Doors:* **"Let us complete our evening prayer..."** (*И҆спо́лнимъ вече́рнюю моли́твꙋ...*). *At the Aposticha of the Triodion; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:" of the Forerunner; "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" Theotokion according to the tone, Sunday Resurrection from the verses. After* **"Now lettest Thou"** (*Ны́нѣ ѿпꙋща́еши*): *troparion of the Forerunner; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" Sunday Resurrection Theotokion; ectene:* **"Have mercy on us, O God..."** (*Поми́лꙋй на́съ, Бо́же...*); *3 great prostrations; and the Dismissal. The Midnight Office we sing according to custom with the Kathisma and customary troparia. After* **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**: *3 great prostrations without the prayer. At Matins: at* **"God is the Lord"** (*Бо́гъ Госпо́дь*): *troparion of the Forerunner 2 times; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" Theotokion. After the 1st and 2nd Kathismata, we say Sessional Hymns of the Triodion; and no ectenes are said. After the 3rd Kathisma, Little Ectene and Sessional Hymn of the Forerunner; Graduals the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4; Prokeimenon and Gospel of the Forerunner;*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: в нлю вечер поем блажен муж а й
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Въ нл҃ю ве́черъ пое́мъ:* Блаже́нъ мꙋ́жъ, *а̄ й а҆нтї́фѡнъ, на* Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ: *стїхи̑ры на і҃. Трїѡ́ди днѐ на д҃ повторя́юще а̄ ю. И҆ предте́чи на ѕ҃, сла́ва предте́чи, и҆ ны́нѣ догма́тъ. Вхо́дъ. Прокі́менъ вели́кїй трїѡ́ди. И҆ чте́нїа предте́чи г҃. А҆́бїе же затворя́ются цр҃кїа врата̀. Та́же,* Сподо́би Гдⷭ҇и въ ве́черъ се́й: *І҆ере́й предъ цр҃кими враты̀:* И҆спо́лнимъ вече́рню мл҃твꙋ: *На стїхо́внѣ трїѡ́ди, сла́ва предте́чи, и҆ ны́нѣ вг҃оро́диченъ по гла́сꙋ воскрнъ ѿ стїхѡ́: По* ны́нѣ ѿпꙋща́еши: *Тропа́рь прⷭ҇течи: сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ вогоро́диченъ воскрнъ: є҆кте́нїа:* Поми́лꙋй на́съ Бж҃е: *Покло́ны г҃ вели́кїа. И҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. Полꙋ́нощницꙋ же пое́мъ по ѻ҆бы́чаю съ каѳі́смою и҆ тропаря́ми ѻ҆бы́чными. По* Честнѣ́йшꙋю, *г҃ покло́ны вели́кїа безъ моли́твы. На оу҆́трени: На* Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь: *тропа́рь предте́чи в҃, сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ вг҃оро́диченъ. По а̄ й и҆ по в҃ ой каѳі́смѣ гле́мъ сѣда́льны трїѡ́ди. И҆ є҆кте́нїи не гл҃ются. По г҃. каѳ. є҆кте́нїа ма́лая И҆ сѣда́ленъ предте́чи Степе́нна а̄ й а҆нтї́фѡнъ д҃, гла́са, прокі́менъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе* --- Page 177 --- *предте́чи и҆ про́чая въ трїѡ́ди. На хвали́техъ стїхи̑ры предте́чи, на д҃, сла́ва предте́чи. Славосло́вїе ма́лое. Посе́мъ є҆кте́нїа:* И҆спо́лнимъ оу҆́треннюю: *Та́же стїхи̑ры на стїхо́внѣ днѐ, сла́ва предте́чи. Посе́мъ* Бл҃го є҆́сть *а̄. По* Ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ: *тропа́рь предте́чи, сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ вг҃оро́диченъ воскрнъ. Є҆кте́нїа:* Поми́лꙋй на́съ Бж҃е: *И҆ г҃ покло́ны вели́кїа. [И҆ ѿпꙋстъ] И҆ ча́съ а̄. На часѣ́хъ тропа́рь гле́мъ предте́чи, и҆ по трїсто́мъ конда́къ, и҆ на коне́цъ г҃ покло́ны вели́кїа: По покло́нахъ трⷭ҇та́гѡ не гле́мъ,* Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣ́те и҆́стинный: *и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. Та́кожде и҆ про́чїи часы̀ гле́мъ. По ѳ҃ мъ часѣ̀ и҆ по моли́твѣ:* Вл҃ко Гдⷭ҇и І҆и҃се Хрⷭ҇тѐ: *гле́мъ и҆ ѱало́мъ:* Бл҃ви Дш҃ѐ моя̀ Гдⷭ҇а, и҆ вся̑ внꙋ́тренная: *Сла́ва,* Хвалѝ дꙋшѐ моя̀ Гдⷭ҇а: *и҆ ны́нѣ,* Є҆диноро́дный сн҃е и҆ сло́ве: *И҆* въ црⷭ҇твїи твое́мъ, *по ско́рꙋ бе́зъ пѣ́нїа. И҆ предте́чи на ѕ҃, сла́ва предте́чи, и҆ ны́нѣ догма́тъ. Вхо́дъ. Прокі́менъ вели́кїй трїѡ́ди. И҆ чте́нїа предте́чи г҃. А҆́бїе же затворя́ются цр҃кїа врата̀. Та́же,* Сподо́би Гдⷭ҇и въ ве́черъ се́й: *І҆ере́й предъ цр҃кими враты̀:* И҆спо́лнимъ вече́рню мл҃твꙋ: *На стїхо́внѣ трїѡ́ди, сла́ва предте́чи, и҆ ны́нѣ вг҃оро́диченъ по гла́сꙋ воскрнъ ѿ стїхѡ́: По* ны́нѣ ѿпꙋща́еши: *Тропа́рь прⷭ҇течи: сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ вогоро́диченъ воскрнъ: є҆кте́нїа:* Поми́лꙋй на́съ Бж҃е: *Покло́ны г҃ вели́кїа. И҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. Полꙋ́нощницꙋ же пое́мъ по ѻ҆бы́чаю съ каѳі́смою и҆ тропаря́ми ѻ҆бы́чными. По* Честнѣ́йшꙋю, *г҃ покло́ны вели́кїа безъ моли́твы. На оу҆́трени: На* Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь: *тропа́рь предте́чи в҃, сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ вг҃оро́диченъ. По а̄ й и҆ по в҃ ой каѳі́смѣ гле́мъ сѣда́льны трїѡ́ди. И҆ є҆кте́нїи не гл҃ются. На хвали́техъ стїхи̑ры предте́чи, на д҃, сла́ва предте́чи. Славосло́вїе ма́лое. Посе́мъ є҆кте́нїа:* И҆спо́лнимъ оу҆́треннюю: *Та́же стїхи̑ры на стїхо́внѣ днѐ, сла́ва предте́чи. Та́кожде и҆ про́чїи часы̀ гле́мъ. По ѳ҃ мъ часѣ̀ и҆ по моли́твѣ:* Вл҃ко Гдⷭ҇и І҆и҃се Хрⷭ҇тѐ: *гле́мъ и҆ ѱало́мъ:* Бл҃ви Дш҃ѐ моя̀ Гдⷭ҇а, и҆ вся̑ внꙋ́тренная: *Сла́ва,* Хвалѝ дꙋшѐ моя̀ Гдⷭ҇а: *и҆ ны́нѣ,* Є҆диноро́дный сн҃е и҆ сло́ве: *И҆* въ црⷭ҇твїи твое́мъ, *по ско́рꙋ бе́зъ пѣ́нїа. На бл҃же́ннахъ гле́мъ предте́чи, пѣ́снь г҃ ю, и҆ ѕ҃ ю. Та́же а҆́пл҃ъ и҆ є҆г҃лїе предте́чи: Посе́мъ* помянѝ на́съ Гдⷭ҇и: *По* ѡ҆сла́би, ѡ҆ста́ви. *И҆ по* Ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ: *конда́къ хра́ма: Сла́ва предте́чи, и҆ ны́нѣ Бц҃ы хра́ма: А҆́ще же нѣ́сть хра́мъ Бц҃ы,* Предста́телство хрїстїа́нъ: *Та́же* Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй: *м҃. И҆ покло́ны г҃, вели́кїа, и҆ въ то вре́мя параекклисїа́рхъ зна́менаетъ въ два̀ кампа́на: и҆ по трїе́хъ покло́нѣхъ вели́кихъ гле́мъ:* Прїиди́те поклони́мся: *И҆ пое́мъ вече́рню, съ покло́нами и҆ тропаря́ми, по ѻ҆бы́чаю по́стномꙋ.*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *ста̀: По покло́нѣхъ вели́кихъ часѡ́въ, чте́цъ глаго́летъ:* Прїиди́те поклони́мся *г҃. Та́же а҆́бїе ѱало́мъ* Бл҃гословѝ дш҃ѐ моя̀ Гдⷭ҇а: *И҆ пое́мъ вече́рню безъ покло́нѡвъ. По ѻ҆бы́чной каѳ. ст҃ры на ѕ҃ трїѡ́ди и҆ предте́чи. Вхо́дъ. И҆* свѣ́те ти́хїй. *Прокі́менъ и҆ чте́нїя днѐ. И҆ прⷭ҇те́чи. А҆́бїе затворя́ются цр҃кїа врата̀.* Сподо́би Гдⷭ҇и: *Та́же,* И҆спо́лнимъ вече́рнюю мл҃твꙋ: *На стїхо́внѣ трїѡ́ди: Сла́ва пре́течи: и҆ ны́нѣ, вг҃оро́диченъ по гла́сꙋ. По* ны́нѣ ѿпꙋща́еши, *тропа́рь прⷭ҇те́чи сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ:* Є҆́же ѿ вѣ́ка оу҆тае́нное. *Є҆кте́нїа:* Поми́лꙋй на́съ Бж҃е: *Посе́мъ г҃ покло́ны вели́кїа. И҆ а҆́бїе моли́тва:* Всест҃а́я Тр҃це: *И҆* Бл҃гословлю̀ Гдⷭ҇а: Досто́йно *и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. Повече́рїе вели́кое безъ покло́нѡвъ. И҆* Гдⷭ҇и си́лъ съ на́ми, *не пое́мъ. По честнѣ́йшꙋю покло́ны г҃ вели́кїа и҆ а҆́бїе ѿпꙋ́стъ. Полꙋ́нощницꙋ, оу҆́тренню и҆ всю̀ слꙋ́жбꙋ прⷭ҇те́чи пое́мъ я҆́кѡже на листѣ̀ 176. Въ гре́ческихъ оу҆ста́вахъ въ де́нь по́стенъ параме́и и҆ полѷеле́а нѣ́сть.*
units.english_cohort_translation: [Book Page 178] *the Fast: After the great prostrations of the Hours, the reader says:* **"Come, let us bow down in worship..."** *3 times; then immediately the Psalm:* **"Bless the Lord, O my soul..."** [Psalm 103]; *and we sing Vespers without prostrations. After the customary Kathisma, stichera to 6 of the Triodion and of the Forerunner. The Entrance; and* **"O Gentle Light"** (*Свѣ́те ти́хїй*). *Prokeimenon and readings of the day, and of the Forerunner. Immediately the church doors are closed.* **"Vouchsafe, O Lord..."**; *then:* **"Let us complete our evening prayer..."** *At the Aposticha of the Triodion; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit:" of the Forerunner; "Now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:" Theotokion according to the tone. After* **"Now lettest Thou"**: *troparion of the Forerunner; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:"* **"The mystery hidden from all ages..."** (*Е҆́же ѿ вѣ́ка оу҆тае́нное...*). *Ectene:* **"Have mercy on us, O God..."**; *thereafter 3 great prostrations. And immediately the prayer:* **"All-Holy Trinity..."**; *and* **"I will bless the Lord at all times..."** [Psalm 33]; **"It is truly meet..."**; *and the Dismissal. Great Compline is sung without prostrations; and* **"Lord of hosts, be with us..."** (*Го́споди си́лъ, съ на́ми бꙋ́ди...*) *we do not sing. After "More honorable than the Cherubim", 3 great prostrations and immediately the Dismissal. The Midnight Office, Matins, and the entire service of the Forerunner we sing as indicated on leaf 176. In the Greek Typika, on a fast day there are no Paremias and no Polyeleos.*[^195]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ☞ *Зрѝ. А҆́щели слꙋчи́тся Ѡ҆брѣ́тенїе чт҃ныѧ главы̀ В СРЕДꙋ И҆ЛЍ ПА́ТОКЪ поста̀. Во вто́рникъ и҆лѝ четверто́къ пое́мъ вече́рню безъ покло́нѡвъ, я҆́ко ма́ло вы́сше. Въ средꙋ же и҆ пато́къ [а҆́ще и҆́матъ бы́ти преждеѡсщ҃еннаѧ]. На часѣ́хъ по* ѡ҆сла́би ѡ҆ста́ви: *и҆ по* Ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ: *кондакѝ по оу҆ста́вꙋ. Та́же* Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй м҃. *сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ* Честнѣ́йшꙋю херꙋві́мъ. *И҆ по покло́нѣхъ гле́мъ трⷭ҇то́е.* Гдⷭ҇и в҃і: *И҆* всеста́я тр҃це:
units.english_cohort_translation: ☞ *Notice: If the Finding of the Precious Head occur ON WEDNESDAY OR FRIDAY of the Fast: on Tuesday or Thursday we sing Vespers without prostrations, as described a little above. On Wednesday and Friday [if there is to be a Presanctified Liturgy]: at the Hours after* **"Remit, pardon..."** *and after "Our Father": kontakia according to the rule; then* **"Lord, have mercy"** *40 times; "Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen:"* **"More honorable than the Cherubim..."**; *and after the prostrations we say the Trisagion;* **"Lord, have mercy"** *12 times; and* **"All-Holy Trinity..."**

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: и абие начинаем вечерню и бычная каф
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *И҆ а҆́бїе начина́емъ вече́рню: И҆ ѻ҆бы́чная каѳ-* --- Page 179 --- *и҆ глаго́лются на не́й є҆кте́нїи по кое́мждо а҆нтїфѡ́нѣ. На* Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ, *стїхи̑ры на і҃, трїѡ́ди днѐ в҃, и҆ мч҃ниченъ, и҆ по́д трїѡ́ди г҃, и҆ прⷭ҇те́чи д҃, Вхо́дъ со є҆г҃лїемъ.* Свѣ́те ти́хїй. *Прокі́менъ и҆ чте́нїа днѐ.* Да и҆спра́вится моли́тва моя̀: *И҆ г҃ покло́ны вели́кїа. Та́же а҆́бїе Прокі́менъ, а҆́пл҃ъ, а҆ллилꙋ́їа и҆ є҆г҃лїе.* Рце́мъ всѝ: *и҆ про́чее пре́деѡсщ҃енныхъ по ѻ҆бы́чаю. На ѿпꙋ́стѣ і҆ере́й помина́етъ пре́жде пра́зднꙋемагѡ ст҃а́гѡ, пото́мъ наста́вшагѡ.*
units.english_cohort_translation: [Book Page 179] *and on it ectenes are said at each Antiphon. At* **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Го́споди воззва́хъ*): *stichera to 10: of the Triodion of the day 2, and the Martyrikon, and under the Triodion 3, and of the Forerunner 4. The Entrance is made with the Gospel.* **"O Gentle Light"** (*Свѣ́те ти́хїй*). *Prokeimenon and readings of the day.* **"Let my prayer be set forth in Thy sight as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice"** (*Да и҆спра́вится моли́тва моя̀, я҆́кѡ кади́ло предъ Тобо́ю: воздѣя́нїе рꙋкꙋ̀ мое́ю, же́ртва вече́рняя*); *and 3 great prostrations. Then immediately Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, and Gospel.* **"Let us all say..."**; *and the rest of the Presanctified Gifts according to custom. At the Dismissal the priest commemorates first the celebrated Saint, then the Saint whose memory is on the morrow.*[^196]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ☞ *Зрѝ. Ст҃а́гѡ же прилꙋчи́вшагѡся на ря́дꙋ, канѡ́нъ пое́мъ на оу҆́тренни по чи́нꙋ, стїхи̑ры же є҆гѡ̀, я҆́же пи́сани ве́черъ, на* Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ, *гле́мъ и҆́хъ на хвали́техъ.*
units.english_cohort_translation: ☞ *Notice: For the Saint occurring in the daily cycle, we sing the canon at Matins in order; but his stichera, which were written in the evening at* **"Lord, I have cried"**, *we say at the Praises.*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ☞ *А҆́щели ѡ҆брѣ́тенїе въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ в҃, и҆ г҃ ю постѡ́въ въ пато́къ вече́рна съ преждеѡсщ҃енною. А҆́ще же нѣ́сть преждеѡсщ҃енныхъ, коне́цъ вече́рни, я҆́коже оу҆каза́ся въ є҆ди́нъ ѿ дне́й по́стныхъ зрѝ вы́сше. На оу҆́трни и҆ на часѣ́хъ тропа́рь и҆ конда́къ є҆дно́мꙋ прⷭ҇те́чи.*
units.english_cohort_translation: ☞ *If the Finding occur on the 2nd or 3rd Saturday of the Fast: on Friday, Vespers is celebrated with the Presanctified Liturgy. But if there be no Presanctified Liturgy, the conclusion of Vespers is as indicated on one of the fast days, see above. At Matins and at the Hours, troparion and kontakion of the Forerunner alone.*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ☞ *А҆́щели предопра́зденство бл҃говѣ́ще́нїа въ четверто́къ є҃ нл҃и постѡ́въ, є҆гда̀ пое́тся вели́кїй канѡ́нъ: пое́мъ предпра́зднество бл҃говѣ́ще́нїа, стїхи̑ры и҆ канѡ́нъ на предѝ въ средꙋ на рядꙋ̀. Ст҃агѡ же мине́и пое́мъ на повече́рїи.*
units.english_cohort_translation: ☞ *If the Forefeast of the Annunciation occur on Thursday of the 5th week of the Fast, when the Great Canon is sung: we sing the Forefeast of the Annunciation, the stichera and canon beforehand on Wednesday in the cycle. But the Saint of the Menaion we sing at Compline.*[^198]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: в҃). *А҆́ще слꙋчи́тся Бл҃говѣ́щенїе в* ПОНЕДѢ́ЛНИКЪ *д҃ я, и҆лѝ є҃ я, и҆лѝ ѕ҃ я нл҃и (седмицы) сты́хъ постѡ́въ. Въ нл҃ю быва́етъ вече́рна ма́лая, на не́й стїхи̑ры пра́з на д҃ и҆ про́чая. Вече́рна же вели́кая быва́етъ съ літі́ею [ѻ҆бы́чнѡ предъ восхожде́нїемъ со́лнца въ понедѣ́льникъ]. Чте́нїа пра́з г҃. На благослове́нїи хлѣ́бѡвъ тропа́рь пра́з г҃. На оу҆́тренни полѷеле́й и҆ є҆г҃лїе пра́з. Славосло́вїе ма́лое, и҆ про́чая слꙋ́жба, я҆́коже въ по́стенъ де́нь предписа́ся на рядꙋ̀ въ трїфологїѡ́нѣ и҆ здѣ́ ниже́. Літꙋргі́а Златоꙋ́стагѡ ст҃агѡ съ вече́рнею и҆ про́чая.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *2). If the Annunciation occur on* MONDAY *of the 4th, 5th, or 6th week of the Holy Fast: On Sunday Little Vespers takes place, at it stichera of the feast to 4, and the rest. And Great Vespers takes place with Litiya [customarily before the rising of the sun on Monday]. Readings of the feast 3. At the blessing of the loaves, troparion of the feast 3 times. At Matins: Polyeleos and Gospel of the feast; Little Doxology, and the rest of the service, as was prescribed for a fasting day in the cycle in the Anthologion and here below. The Divine Liturgy of the Holy Chrysostom with Vespers, and the rest.*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: г҃) *А҆́ще слꙋчи́тся Бл҃говѣ́щенїе въ* ДНИ ПО́СТНЫЯ *д҃ я, є҃ я, и҆ ѕ҃ я седми́цы поста̀, сі́есть: во вто́рникъ, средꙋ̀, четверто́къ и҆ пато́къ, тогда̀ въ предпра́зднство ве́черъ [а҆́ще среда̀ и҆лѝ пато́къ] начина́емъ вече́рню безъ каѳисмы. На* Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ *ста́вимъ стїхѡ́въ ѕ҃, . и҆ пое́мъ трїѡ́ди днѐ в҃, и҆ пра́з г҃ повтаря́юще двѣ̀. Бг҃о́ди. Чте́нїа днѐ и҆ пра́здника г҃, а̄ е бытїа̀:* И҆зы́ди І҆а́кѡвъ: *в҃ е Прор. І҆езек:* Бꙋ́детъ ѿ днѐ ѻ҆сма́гѡ. *г҃ е Притчей:* Премꙋ́дрость созда̀. *Та́же:* Да и҆спра́вится. *И҆ покло́ны г҃ вели́кїа. И҆ про́чее преждеѡсщ҃енныхъ.*
units.english_cohort_translation: *3). If the Annunciation occur on* FASTING DAYS *of the 4th, 5th, and 6th week of the Fast, that is to say: on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday: then on the Forefeast in the evening [if Wednesday or Friday] we begin Vespers without a Kathisma. At* **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Го́споди воззва́хъ*): *we set 6 stichera, and we sing of the Triodion of the day 2, and of the feast 3 repeating two; Theotokion. Readings of the day and of the feast 3: the 1st from Genesis:* **"Jacob went forth..."** (*И҆зы́ди І҆а́кѡвъ...*); *the 2nd from the Prophet Ezekiel:* **"It shall be from the eighth day..."** (*Бꙋ́детъ ѿ днѐ ѻ҆сма́гѡ...*); *the 3rd from Proverbs:* **"Wisdom hath builded..."** (*Премꙋ́дрость созда̀...*). *Then:* **"Let my prayer be set forth..."** (*Да и҆спра́вится...*); *and 3 great prostrations; and the rest of the Presanctified.*
